patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n221\t    return choices\n222\t\n223\t\n224\tdef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n225\t                            guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n226\t                            ) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n227\t    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n228\t    if hero is None:\n229\t        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n230\t    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n231\t    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n232\t                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n233\t        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n234\t    return hero, patch_id\n235\t\n236\t\n237\tdef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n238\t    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n239\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n240\t    cur = conn.execute(\n241\t        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n242\t        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n243\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n244\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n245\t    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n246\t    assert guide_id is not None\n247\t    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n248\t    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n249\t    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n250\t        n += 1\n251\t        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n252\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n253\t    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n254\t    assert new is not None\n255\t    return new\n256\t\n257\t\n258\tdef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n259\t    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n260\t    if found is None:\n261\t        raise GuideNotFound\n262\t    return found\n263\t\n264\t\n265\t# A Guide's or a Page's slug: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, in\n266\t# hyphenated runs.\n267\tSLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n268\t\n269\t\n270\tdef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n271\t                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n272\t    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n273\t    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n274\t        return current.slug\n275\t    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n276\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n277\t    slug = slug.strip()\n278\t    if not SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n279\t        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n280\t    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n281\t                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n282\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n283\t    return slug\n284\t\n285\t\n286\tdef can_edit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n287\t    \"\"\"Whether `actor` edits `guide` itself. Admins edit any Guide they see;\n288\t    an Editor's Published Guide changes only through a Revision.\"\"\"\n289\t    return guide.status != \"published\" or actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\")\n290\t\n291\t\n292\tdef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n293\t         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n294\t    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n295\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n296\t    if not can_edit(actor, current):\n297\t        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n298\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n299\t    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n300\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n301\t        _check_text(fields)\n302\t    conn.execute(\n303\t        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n304\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n305\t        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n306\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n307\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n308\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n309\t\n310\t\n311\tdef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide | Revision) -> None:\n312\t    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n313\t    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n314\t        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n315\t    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n316\t        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n317\t\n318\t\n319\tdef _check_not_banned(actor: User) -> None:\n320\t    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n321\t        raise NotAllowed(SUBMISSION_BANNED)\n322\t\n323\t\n324\tdef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n325\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n326\t    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n327\t    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n328\t            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n329\t\n330\t\n331\tdef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n332\t    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n333\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n334\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n335\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n336\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n337\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n338\t                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n339\t    _check_not_banned(actor)\n340\t    _check_text(current)\n341\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n342\t                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n343\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n344\t\n345\t\n346\tdef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n347\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n348\t    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n349\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n350\t        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n351\t        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n352\t\n353\t\n354\tdef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n355\t    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n356\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n357\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n358\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n359\t    if current.status == \"published\":\n360\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n361\t    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n362\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n363\t    _check_text(current)\n364\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n365\t                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n366\t                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n367\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n368\t\n369\t\n370\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n371\tclass ReviewNote:\n372\t    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n373\t    quote: str\n374\t    advice: str\n375\t\n376\t\n377\tROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n378\t\n379\t\n380\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n381\tclass ReviewRound:\n382\t    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish (of a Guide) or Return (of a Revision), with\n383\t    the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n384\t    kind: str\n385\t    of_revision: bool\n386\t    admin_name: str\n387\t    created_at: str\n388\t    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n389\t\n390\t    @property\n391\t    def label(self) -> str:\n392\t        return \"退回修订\" if self.of_revision else ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n393\t\n394\t\n395\tdef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n396\t                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n397\t    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, and the Returns\n398\t    of its Revisions that are no longer open, newest first.\"\"\"\n399\t    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n400\t    return _rounds(conn, \"guide_id = ? AND (revision_id IS NULL\"\n401\t                   \" OR revision_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM revisions))\", (guide_id,))\n402\t\n403\t\n404\tdef revision_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n405\t                    guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n406\t    \"\"\"Every Return of the Guide's open Revision, newest first.\"\"\"\n407\t    _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n408\t    return _rounds(conn, \"revision_id = (SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?)\",\n409\t                   (guide_id,))\n410\t\n411\t\n412\tdef _rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, where: str,\n413\t            params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n414\t    rows = conn.execute(\n415\t        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, revision_id, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n416\t        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n417\t        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n418\t        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n419\t        f\" WHERE {where} ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n420\t        params).fetchall()\n421\t    rounds = []\n422\t    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n423\t        group = list(group)\n424\t        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n425\t        # whose note columns are NULL.\n426\t        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n427\t                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n428\t        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n429\t                                  of_revision=group[0][\"revision_id\"] is not None,\n430\t                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n431\t                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n432\t    return rounds\n433\t\n434\t\n435\tdef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n436\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n437\t    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n438\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n439\t\n440\t\n441\tdef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n442\t                        item: Guide | Revision) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n443\t    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n444\t    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n445\t    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n446\t    again. A Revision has rounds of its own; a Guide's leave out those of its\n447\t    past Revisions, which quoted the Revision's text.\"\"\"\n448\t    if isinstance(item, Revision):\n449\t        rounds = revision_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n450\t    elif item.status == \"published\":\n451\t        return [], []\n452\t    else:\n453\t        rounds = [round for round in review_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n454\t                  if not round.of_revision]\n455\t    if not rounds:\n456\t        return [], []\n457\t    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n458\t    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n459\t        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n460\t        if quote not in latest]\n461\t    return latest, earlier\n462\t\n463\t\n464\tdef _checked_notes(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision,\n465\t                   notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n466\t    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n467\t    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n468\t    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n469\t    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n470\t        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n471\t    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n472\t    glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n473\t    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh, \"zh\", glossary).html, quotes)[1]\n474\t             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en, \"en\", glossary).html, quotes)[1])\n475\t    for quote in quotes:\n476\t        if quote not in found:\n477\t            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n478\t                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n479\t    return notes\n480\t\n481\t\n482\tdef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n483\t               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n484\t    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n485\t    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n486\t    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n487\t    changed = conn.execute(\n488\t        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n489\t        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n490\t    if not changed:\n491\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n492\t    _record_round(conn, actor, current.id, kind, notes)\n493\t    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n494\t\n495\t\n496\tdef _record_round(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int, kind: str,\n497\t                  notes: list[ReviewNote], revision_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n498\t    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, revision_id, admin_id,\"\n499\t                       \" kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n500\t                       (guide_id, revision_id, actor.id, kind))\n501\t    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n502\t                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n503\t                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n504\t\n505\t\n506\tdef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n507\t                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n508\t    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n509\t    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n510\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n511\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n512\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n513\t    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n514\t        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n515\t    notes = _checked_notes(conn, current, notes)\n516\t    if not notes:\n517\t        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n518\t    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n519\t\n520\t\n521\tdef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n522\t              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n523\t    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n524\t    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any. An open\n525\t    Revision is kept, but back as a Draft: there is nothing for it to change\n526\t    until the Guide is Published again.\"\"\"\n527\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n528\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n529\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n530\t    if current.status != \"published\":\n531\t        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n532\t    unpublished = _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n533\t                             _checked_notes(conn, current, notes))\n534\t    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n535\t                 \" WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted'\", (guide_id,))\n536\t    return unpublished\n537\t\n538\t\n539\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n540\tclass Revision:\n541\t    \"\"\"A pending change to a Published Guide: its own copy of the texts, Hero\n542\t    and Patch, with its own status (Draft or Submitted). It has the Guide's\n543\t    slug and Author, and reads like a Guide wherever a page shows one.\"\"\"\n544\t    guide: Guide\n545\t    title_zh: str\n546\t    body_zh: str\n547\t    title_en: str\n548\t    body_en: str\n549\t    hero_id: int\n550\t    hero_name_zh: str\n551\t    hero_name_en: str\n552\t    hero_slug: str\n553\t    patch_id: int\n554\t    patch_name: str\n555\t    status: str\n556\t    base_updated_at: str  # the Guide's updated_at when this was opened\n557\t    created_at: str\n558\t    updated_at: str\n559\t    returned: bool  # a Draft that an Admin Returned\n560\t    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = True\n561\t\n562\t    @property\n563\t    def guide_changed_since(self) -> bool:\n564\t        \"\"\"Whether the Guide changed after this was opened (an Admin's edit,\n565\t        an Unpublish), so that Publishing this would undo that change.\"\"\"\n566\t        return self.guide.updated_at != self.base_updated_at\n567\t\n568\t    @property\n569\t    def id(self) -> int:\n570\t        return self.guide.id\n571\t\n572\t    @property\n573\t    def slug(self) -> str:\n574\t        return self.guide.slug\n575\t\n576\t    @property\n577\t    def author_id(self) -> int:\n578\t        return self.guide.author_id\n579\t\n580\t    @property\n581\t    def author_name(self) -> str:\n582\t        return self.guide.author_name\n583\t\n584\t    @property\n585\t    def status_label(self) -> str:\n586\t        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n587\t\n588\t    @property\n589\t    def console_path(self) -> str:\n590\t        return f\"{self.guide.console_path}/revision\"\n591\t\n592\t\n593\t_REVISION_SELECT = \"\"\"\n594\tSELECT revisions.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n595\t       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name,\n596\t       (revisions.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n597\t         WHERE review_rounds.revision_id = revisions.id)) AS returned\n598\tFROM revisions\n599\tJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = revisions.hero_id\n600\tJOIN patches ON patches.id = revisions.patch_id\n601\t\"\"\"\n602\t\n603\t\n604\tdef revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision | None:\n605\t    \"\"\"The Guide's open Revision, or None if it has none or `actor` may not\n606\t    see the Guide.\"\"\"\n607\t    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n608\t    if found is None:\n609\t        return None\n610\t    row = conn.execute(f\"{_REVISION_SELECT} WHERE revisions.guide_id = ?\",\n611\t                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n612\t    if row is None:\n613\t        return None\n614\t    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Revision)\n615\t              if field.name != \"guide\"}\n616\t    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])\n617\t    return Revision(guide=found, **fields)\n618\t\n619\t\n620\tdef _open(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n621\t    found = revision(conn, actor, guide_id)\n622\t    if found is None:\n623\t        _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)  # not found at all, rather than no Revision\n624\t        raise GuideNotFound(\"这篇攻略没有打开的修订。\")\n625\t    return found\n626\t\n627\t\n628\tdef can_open_revision(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n629\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the 修订 button on `guide`: an Editor revises\n630\t    their own Published Guide; an Admin edits it directly instead.\"\"\"\n631\t    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"published\"\n632\t            and guide.revision_status is None and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"))\n633\t\n634\t\n635\tdef open_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n636\t    \"\"\"The Author starts a Revision of their Published Guide, as a Draft copy\n637\t    of its texts, Hero and Patch.\"\"\"\n638\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n639\t    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n640\t        raise Refused(\"管理员可以直接修改已发布的攻略，不需要修订。\")\n641\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n642\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以修订这篇攻略。\")\n643\t    if current.status != \"published\":\n644\t        raise Refused(\"只有已发布的攻略需要修订；草稿和待审核的攻略可以直接修改。\")\n645\t    _check_not_banned(actor)  # a Revision they could never Submit\n646\t    try:\n647\t        conn.execute(\n648\t            \"INSERT INTO revisions (guide_id, base_updated_at, title_zh, body_zh,\"\n649\t            \" title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id) SELECT id, updated_at, title_zh,\"\n650\t            \" body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id FROM guides WHERE id = ?\",\n651\t            (guide_id,))\n652\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:  # the Guide already has one\n653\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经有一份修订了，请继续修改那一份。\") from None\n654\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n655\t\n656\t\n657\tdef save_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n658\t                  fields: GuideFields) -> Revision:\n659\t    \"\"\"Save changes to the open Revision without changing its status. The\n660\t    slug is the Guide's and stays as it is.\"\"\"\n661\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n662\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n663\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n664\t        _check_text(fields)\n665\t    conn.execute(\n666\t        \"UPDATE revisions SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n667\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\",\n668\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n669\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, guide_id))\n670\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n671\t\n672\t\n673\tdef can_submit_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n674\t    return (revision.author_id == An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\nits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\nGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\nGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\ndirectly.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\nDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\nTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\nfrom typing import ClassVar\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import SUBMISSION_BANNED, User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    trashed_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n    revision_status: str | None  # the open Revision's status, if there is one\n    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = False\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Where the Guide's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n        return f\"admin/guides/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide | Revision) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id\n           AND review_rounds.revision_id IS NULL)) AS returned,\n       (SELECT status FROM revisions WHERE revisions.guide_id = guides.id)\n         AS revision_status\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\n_NOT_TRASHED = \"guides.trashed_at IS NULL\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Guide)}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see (none in\n    the Trash).\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return _NOT_TRASHED, ()\n    return f\"guides.author_id = ? AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published' AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n                            ) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n# A Guide's or a Page's slug: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, in\n# hyphenated runs.\nSLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef can_edit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether `actor` edits `guide` itself. Admins edit any Guide they see;\n    an Editor's Published Guide changes only through a Revision.\"\"\"\n    return guide.status != \"published\" or actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\")\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not can_edit(actor, current):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide | Revision) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n\n\ndef _check_not_banned(actor: User) -> None:\n    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n        raise NotAllowed(SUBMISSION_BANNED)\n\n\ndef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewNote:\n    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n    quote: str\n    advice: str\n\n\nROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ReviewRound:\n    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish (of a Guide) or Return (of a Revision), with\n    the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n    kind: str\n    of_revision: bool\n    admin_name: str\n    created_at: str\n    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return \"退回修订\" if self.of_revision else ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, and the Returns\n    of its Revisions that are no longer open, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    return _rounds(conn, \"guide_id = ? AND (revision_id IS NULL\"\n                   \" OR revision_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM revisions))\", (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef revision_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    \"\"\"Every Return of the Guide's open Revision, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    return _rounds(conn, \"revision_id = (SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?)\",\n                   (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef _rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, where: str,\n            params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, revision_id, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n        f\" WHERE {where} ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n        params).fetchall()\n    rounds = []\n    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n        group = list(group)\n        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n        # whose note columns are NULL.\n        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n                                  of_revision=group[0][\"revision_id\"] is not None,\n                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n    return rounds\n\n\ndef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                        item: Guide | Revision) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n    again. A Revision has rounds of its own; a Guide's leave out those of its\n    past Revisions, which quoted the Revision's text.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(item, Revision):\n        rounds = revision_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n    elif item.status == \"published\":\n        return [], []\n    else:\n        rounds = [round for round in review_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n                  if not round.of_revision]\n    if not rounds:\n        return [], []\n    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n        if quote not in latest]\n    return latest, earlier\n\n\ndef _checked_notes(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision,\n                   notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n    glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh, \"zh\", glossary).html, quotes)[1]\n             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en, \"en\", glossary).html, quotes)[1])\n    for quote in quotes:\n        if quote not in found:\n            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n    changed = conn.execute(\n        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n    if not changed:\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    _record_round(conn, actor, current.id, kind, notes)\n    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n\n\ndef _record_round(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int, kind: str,\n                  notes: list[ReviewNote], revision_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, revision_id, admin_id,\"\n                       \" kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                       (guide_id, revision_id, actor.id, kind))\n    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n\n\ndef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(conn, current, notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n\n\ndef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any. An open\n    Revision is kept, but back as a Draft: there is nothing for it to change\n    until the Guide is Published again.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n    unpublished = _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n                             _checked_notes(conn, current, notes))\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted'\", (guide_id,))\n    return unpublished\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Revision:\n    \"\"\"A pending change to a Published Guide: its own copy of the texts, Hero\n    and Patch, with its own status (Draft or Submitted). It has the Guide's\n    slug and Author, and reads like a Guide wherever a page shows one.\"\"\"\n    guide: Guide\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    status: str\n    base_updated_at: str  # the Guide's updated_at when this was opened\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that an Admin Returned\n    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = True\n\n    @property\n    def guide_changed_since(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Whether the Guide changed after this was opened (an Admin's edit,\n        an Unpublish), so that Publishing this would undo that change.\"\"\"\n        return self.guide.updated_at != self.base_updated_at\n\n    @property\n    def id(self) -> int:\n        return self.guide.id\n\n    @property\n    def slug(self) -> str:\n        return self.guide.slug\n\n    @property\n    def author_id(self) -> int:\n        return self.guide.author_id\n\n    @property\n    def author_name(self) -> str:\n        return self.guide.author_name\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"{self.guide.console_path}/revision\"\n\n\n_REVISION_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT revisions.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name,\n       (revisions.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.revision_id = revisions.id)) AS returned\nFROM revisions\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = revisions.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = revisions.patch_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide's open Revision, or None if it has none or `actor` may not\n    see the Guide.\"\"\"\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_REVISION_SELECT} WHERE revisions.guide_id = ?\",\n                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        return None\n    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Revision)\n              if field.name != \"guide\"}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])\n    return Revision(guide=found, **fields)\n\n\ndef _open(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n    found = revision(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)  # not found at all, rather than no Revision\n        raise GuideNotFound(\"这篇攻略没有打开的修订。\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef can_open_revision(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the 修订 button on `guide`: an Editor revises\n    their own Published Guide; an Admin edits it directly instead.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"published\"\n            and guide.revision_status is None and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"))\n\n\ndef open_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"The Author starts a Revision of their Published Guide, as a Draft copy\n    of its texts, Hero and Patch.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        raise Refused(\"管理员可以直接修改已发布的攻略，不需要修订。\")\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以修订这篇攻略。\")\n    if current.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只有已发布的攻略需要修订；草稿和待审核的攻略可以直接修改。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)  # a Revision they could never Submit\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO revisions (guide_id, base_updated_at, title_zh, body_zh,\"\n            \" title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id) SELECT id, updated_at, title_zh,\"\n            \" body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id FROM guides WHERE id = ?\",\n            (guide_id,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:  # the Guide already has one\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经有一份修订了，请继续修改那一份。\") from None\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef save_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to the open Revision without changing its status. The\n    slug is the Guide's and stays as it is.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE revisions SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, guide_id))\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_submit_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n    return (revision.author_id == actor.id and revision.status == \"draft\"\n            and revision.guide.status == \"published\")\n\n\ndef submit_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Revision finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交修订。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订已经提交审核了。\")\n    if current.guide.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已被撤下。修订只能在攻略重新发布后提交；\"\n                      \"也可以直接修改攻略草稿。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_discard_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n    return revision.author_id == actor.id\n\n\ndef discard_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The Author throws their open Revision away, so they can open a new one\n    later. The Published Guide is untouched; Returns of the Revision stay in\n    its history.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not can_discard_revision(actor, current):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以放弃修订。\")\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef can_publish_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and revision.status == \"submitted\"\n\n\ndef publish_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Revision: it replaces the Guide's texts, Hero and\n    Patch (the old ones are not kept) and is gone. The slug stays, and the\n    Guide's 更新于 date moves on. Readers see it at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布修订。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n    _check_text(current)\n    # Checked again as it is deleted, so a Revision another Admin Returned\n    # meanwhile is refused rather than Published.\n    if not conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted'\",\n                        (guide_id,)).rowcount:\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\",\n        (current.title_zh, current.body_zh, current.title_en, current.body_en,\n         current.hero_id, current.patch_id, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef return_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                    notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Revision back to its Author as a Draft,\n    with at least one Review note. The Published Guide stays as it is.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回修订。\")\n    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的修订。\")\n    notes = _checked_notes(conn, current, notes)\n    if not notes:\n        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n    row = conn.execute(f\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                       \" WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted' RETURNING id\",\n                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:  # another Admin got there first\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n    _record_round(conn, actor, guide_id, \"return\", notes, revision_id=row[\"id\"])\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _revisions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, where: str,\n               params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[Revision]:\n    \"\"\"The open Revisions matching `where`, of Guides `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT guide_id FROM revisions WHERE {where}\", params)\n    found = [revision(conn, actor, row[\"guide_id\"]) for row in rows.fetchall()]\n    return [item for item in found if item is not None]\n\n\ndef delete(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move a Guide, in whatever status and with any open Revision, to the\n    Trash. Anyone who can see a Guide can delete it: an Editor their own, an\n    Admin any. A Published one leaves the site at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE guides SET trashed_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef trashed(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Guide in the Trash, most recently deleted first. Admins only.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以查看回收站。\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.trashed_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef in_trash(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, if it is in the Trash. Admins only.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以查看回收站。\")\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\",\n                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound(\"回收站里没有这篇攻略。\")\n    return _guide_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef restore(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Guide out of the Trash. Its status, texts, Review\n    notes and open Revision never changed there, so it is back as it was.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以从回收站恢复攻略。\")\n    if not conn.execute(f\"UPDATE guides SET trashed_at = NULL, restored_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                        f\" WHERE id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (guide_id,)).rowcount:\n        raise GuideNotFound(\"回收站里没有这篇攻略。\")\n\n\ndef delete_for_good(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An Admin deletes a Guide in the Trash for good, with its Review notes\n    and any open Revision. It cannot be restored.\"\"\"\n    if in_trash(conn, actor, guide_id).status == \"published\":\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO removed_guides (guide_id) VALUES (?)\", (guide_id,))\n    conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM guides WHERE id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (guide_id,))\n\n\ndef trash_changes_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n    \"\"\"The ids of Published Guides moved to the Trash, restored from it, or\n    deleted from it for good after `since`: the next Site build drops or adds\n    them. It may count one the site never had (or already lacks), such as a\n    Guide deleted and restored in between, but never misses one.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT id FROM guides WHERE status = 'published'\"\n        \" AND (trashed_at > ? OR (trashed_at IS NULL AND restored_at > ?))\"\n        \" UNION SELECT guide_id FROM removed_guides WHERE removed_at > ?\",\n        (since, since, since)).fetchall()\n    return {row[0] for row in rows}\n\n\ndef unpublished_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n    \"\"\"The ids of Guides Unpublished after `since` and not Published again:\n    the Site build reads Published Guides only, so they drop out of it.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT guide_id FROM review_rounds JOIN guides\"\n        \" ON guides.id = review_rounds.guide_id WHERE kind = 'unpublish'\"\n        \" AND review_rounds.created_at > ? AND guides.status != 'published'\",\n        (since,)).fetchall()\n    return {row[\"guide_id\"] for row in rows}\n\n\ndef review_queue(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide | Revision]:\n    \"\"\"Every Submitted Guide and Revision waiting for an Admin, longest\n    waiting first (as far as the last change shows); nothing for anyone who\n    can't review.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        return []\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'submitted'\"\n                        f\" AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\").fetchall()\n    queue = [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n    queue += _revisions(conn, actor, \"status = 'submitted'\", ())\n    return sorted(queue, key=lambda item: (item.updated_at, item.id))\n\n\ndef returned_to(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide | Revision]:\n    \"\"\"`actor`'s own Guides and Revisions that an Admin sent back to them and\n    that they have not Submitted again, most recently sent back first.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.author_id = ? AND returned\"\n                        f\" AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (actor.id,)).fetchall()\n    returned = [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n    returned += [item for item in _revisions(\n        conn, actor, \"status = 'draft' AND guide_id IN\"\n        \" (SELECT id FROM guides WHERE author_id = ?)\", (actor.id,)) if item.returned]\n    return sorted(returned, key=lambda item: (item.updated_at, item.id), reverse=True)\n\n\ndef counts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides `actor` may see are in each status.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM guides WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" GROUP BY status\", params).fetchall()\n    found = {row[\"status\"]: row[\"n\"] for row in rows}\n    return {status: found.get(status, 0) for status in STATUS_LABELS}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass AuthorCounts:\n    published: int = 0\n    total: int = 0     # in any status, outside the Trash\n\n\ndef counts_by_author(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> dict[int, AuthorCounts]:\n    \"\"\"Each Author's Guides outside the Trash, for the Users page, keyed by\n    user id; an Author with none is missing.\"\"\"\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_users\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以查看所有人的攻略数量。\")\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT author_id, SUM(status = 'published') AS published,\"\n        f\" COUNT(*) AS total FROM guides WHERE {_NOT_TRASHED} GROUP BY author_id\"\n    ).fetchall()\n    return {row[\"author_id\"]: AuthorCounts(row[\"published\"], row[\"total\"])\n            for row in rows}\n","numLines":886,"startLine":1,"totalLines":886}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"58aa6746-d625-4346-a2aa-bd9592959175","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Every change goes through app/guides.py, which decides who may make\nit; these routes only turn its answers into pages.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom itertools import zip_longest\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, preview_warnings, render_markdown\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import Guide, GuideFields, ReviewNote, Revision\nfrom app.web import (AdminRequired, flash, form_text, id_or_none, redirect,\n                     signed_in_user, templates)\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef _fields_from(form: FormData) -> GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"The Guide form's fields. A missing text field counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422; the slug stays None unless the form\n    has a slug field (only Admins' does).\"\"\"\n    def text(name: str) -> str:\n        return form_text(form, name)\n    slug = form.get(\"slug\")\n    return GuideFields(title_zh=text(\"title_zh\"), body_zh=text(\"body_zh\"),\n                       title_en=text(\"title_en\"), body_en=text(\"body_en\"),\n                       hero_id=id_or_none(text(\"hero_id\")),\n                       patch_id=id_or_none(text(\"patch_id\")),\n                       slug=slug if isinstance(slug, str) else None)\n\n\nasync def guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields:\n    return _fields_from(await request.form())\n\n\nasync def sent_guide_fields(request: Request) -> GuideFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a workflow button sent them along (it\n    sits inside the form), or None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return _fields_from(form) if \"hero_id\" in form else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n        rounds = guides.review_rounds(conn, user, guide.id) if guide else []\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if guide else \"写攻略\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"error\": error,\n         \"review_rounds\": rounds, \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"can_submit\": guide is not None and guides.can_submit(user, guide),\n         \"can_publish\": guide is not None and guides.can_publish(user, guide),\n         \"can_review\": guide is not None and guides.can_review(user, guide),\n         \"can_open_revision\": (guide is not None\n                               and guides.can_open_revision(user, guide)),\n         \"can_edit\": guide is None or guides.can_edit(user, guide)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef visible_guide(guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide in the URL, or 404 if it doesn't exist or isn't this user's\n    to see.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return guide\n\n\ndef refused_page(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                 fields: GuideFields | None, refused: guides.Refused):\n    \"\"\"Show the editor again with the reason, keeping what was typed.\"\"\"\n    guide = visible_guide(guide_id, user)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields or GuideFields.of(guide),\n                       error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef guide_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               status: str = \"\", hero: str = \"\", author: str = \"\",\n               patch: str = \"\", lang: str = \"\"):\n    filters = guides.GuideFilter(\n        status=status if status in guides.STATUS_LABELS else \"\",\n        hero_id=id_or_none(hero), author_id=id_or_none(author),\n        patch_id=id_or_none(patch),\n        language=lang if lang in guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS else \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.guides(conn, user, filters)\n        heroes, patches = game.heroes(conn), game.patches(conn)\n        authors = guides.authors(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guides.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"filters\": filters,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"languages\": guides.LANGUAGE_LABELS,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"authors\": authors,\n         \"filtered\": filters != guides.GuideFilter()})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, GuideFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef create_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide.id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_guide_form(request: Request,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\ndef preview_page(request: Request, user: User, item: Guide | Revision):\n    \"\"\"The Guide (or Revision) as Readers will see it, with the passages its\n    Review notes quote highlighted, the latest round's set apart from earlier\n    rounds' (here only: the Site build never highlights), and warnings about\n    its Game Term markers and nicknames, which never block Submit.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        latest, earlier = guides.quotes_to_highlight(conn, user, item)\n        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    rendered_zh = render_markdown(item.body_zh, \"zh\", glossary)\n    rendered_en = render_markdown(item.body_en, \"en\", glossary)\n    body_zh, found_zh = highlight(rendered_zh.html, latest, earlier)\n    body_en, found_en = highlight(rendered_en.html, latest, earlier)\n    term_warnings = preview_warnings(item.title_zh, item.title_en, rendered_zh,\n                                     rendered_en, glossary)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_preview.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"预览：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": item, \"body_zh\": body_zh, \"body_en\": body_en,\n         \"quotes\": latest + earlier, \"earlier\": earlier,\n         \"found\": found_zh | found_en, \"term_warnings\": term_warnings})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return preview_page(request, user, guide)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\nWorkflowStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int], Guide | Revision]\n\n\ndef workflow_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                  fields: GuideFields | None, step: WorkflowStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a workflow button. When the editor form came along, its edits are\n    saved in the same transaction: if the step is refused they are not saved\n    either, and the editor shows them again with the reason.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n            step(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.submit,\n                         \"已提交审核，请等待管理员审核。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                  fields: Annotated[GuideFields | None, Depends(sent_guide_fields)]):\n    return workflow_step(request, user, guide_id, fields, guides.publish,\n                         \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会在公开网站上看到它。\")\n\n\nasync def sent_review_notes(request: Request) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n    \"\"\"The Review note builder's rows, in order. Rows left wholly blank are\n    dropped; a half-filled row is kept, for app/guides.py to refuse.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    def texts(name: str) -> list[str]:  # anything but text (a file) is blank\n        return [value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\" for value in form.getlist(name)]\n    rows = zip_longest(texts(\"quote\"), texts(\"advice\"), fillvalue=\"\")\n    return [ReviewNote(quote, advice) for quote, advice in rows\n            if quote.strip() or advice.strip()]\n\n\nBLANK_NOTE_ROWS = 3\n\n\ndef review_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | Revision,\n                notes: list[ReviewNote], *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    rows = notes + [ReviewNote(\"\", \"\")] * max(BLANK_NOTE_ROWS - len(notes), 1)\n    kind = \"修订\" if guide.is_revision else \"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_review.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"审核{kind}：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\", \"user\": user,\n         \"guide\": guide, \"notes\": rows, \"error\": error,\n         \"body_zh\": render_markdown(guide.body_zh, \"zh\", glossary).html,\n         \"body_en\": render_markdown(guide.body_en, \"en\", glossary).html},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/review\")\ndef review_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    if not user.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n        raise AdminRequired(user)\n    return review_page(request, user, guide, [])\n\n\nReviewStep = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, User, int, list[ReviewNote]],\n                     Guide | Revision]\n\n\ndef review_step(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                notes: list[ReviewNote], step: ReviewStep, done: str):\n    \"\"\"Send a Guide back with the Review notes from the review screen. visible_guide(guide_id, user), notes,\n                           error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, done)\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/return\")\ndef return_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User,          \"已退回给作者，作者会在草稿顶部看到审核意见。\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/unpublish\")\ndef unpublish_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                    user: Annotated[User,     glossary=glossary, nav_pages=pages)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang,\n                   guides=newest[:NEWEST_ON_HOME], heroes=heroes)\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/\", \"site/guides.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n        write_tournaments(write, lang, tournament_items)\n        for page in pages:\n            # A Chinese-only Page's switch leads to the English home page.\n            if page.has_text_in(lang):\n                write.page(f\"{lang}/{page.slug}/\", \"site/page.html\", lang=lang,\n                           page=page, switch_to=None if page.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                           else f\"#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\ndef write_tournaments(write: _Writer, lang: str,\n                      items: list[content.TournamentItem]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The 锦标赛 list and each item's page, in one language tree. A recap\n    links to its announcement where that is on the same tree; a Chinese-only\n    item's switch leads to the English list.\"\"\"\n    listed = [item for item in items if item.has_text_in(lang)]\n    on_tree = {item.id: item for item in listed}\n    write.page(f\"{lang}/tournaments/\", \"site/tournaments.html\", lang=lang,\n               items=listed)\n    for item in listed:\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/tournaments/{item.id}/\", \"site/tournament_item.html\",\n                   lang=lang, item=item,\n                   announcement=on_tree.get(item.announcement_id or 0),\n                   switch_to=None if item.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                   else f\"tournaments/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides, Pages and Tournament items changed since the last\n    successful Site build started (all of them, if there has never been\n    one): Published Guides edited since, Guides Unpublished since, which the\n    next build leaves out, Published Guides moved to or restored from the\n    Trash since, and the Page and Tournament changes content.changes_since\n    counts.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return (len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n                | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n            + content.changes_since(conn, last))\n","numLines":249,"startLine":1,"totalLines":249}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4e89b5f7-d4f3-4319-a658-88e686db34cb","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}
