{"parentUuid":"537da1f3-96ef-4280-8404-2e1df7b4d8dc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dab45f80-42a3-444d-8092-be343cf2ed99","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01415PN4RQHa1XhMAj5pWLiS","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\n2\tthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\n3\tthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n4\t\n5\tA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\n6\tOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\n7\tin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\n8\twritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\n9\tpreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\n10\tnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\n11\tanything.\n12\t\n13\tWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\n14\twith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\n15\thandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\n16\tsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\n17\tfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n18\t\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\timport re\n22\tfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\n23\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n24\tfrom html import escape\n25\tfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n26\tfrom itertools import groupby\n27\t\n28\timport nh3\n29\tfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n30\tfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\n31\tfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\n32\tfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n33\tfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n34\t\n35\tfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n36\t\n37\t_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n38\t\n39\t\n40\tdef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n41\t    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n42\t    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n43\t    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n44\t    if not matches:\n45\t        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n46\t                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n47\t        return None\n48\t    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n49\t    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n50\t        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n51\t                          for term in matches)\n52\t        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n53\t                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n54\t    return name\n55\t\n56\t\n57\tdef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n58\t    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n59\t    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n60\t    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n61\t    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n62\t    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n63\t    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n64\t    if not match:\n65\t        return False\n66\t    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n67\t    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n68\t    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n69\t    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n70\t    state.pos = match.end()\n71\t    return True\n72\t\n73\t\n74\tclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n75\t    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n76\t                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n77\t        token = tokens[idx]\n78\t        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n79\t            return escape(token.content)\n80\t        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n81\t\n82\t    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n83\t                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n84\t        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n85\t        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n86\t            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n87\t             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n88\t            options, env)\n89\t\n90\t\n91\t_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n92\t                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n93\t_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n94\t\n95\t\n96\tdef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n97\t    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n98\t    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n99\t        return None\n100\t    return value\n101\t\n102\t\n103\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n104\tclass Rendered:\n105\t    html: str\n106\t    warnings: list[str]\n107\t\n108\t\n109\tdef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n110\t    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n111\t    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n112\t    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n113\t    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n114\t                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n115\t                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n116\t    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n117\t    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n118\t\n119\t\n120\tdef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n121\t    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n122\t    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n123\t    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n124\t            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n125\t            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n126\t            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n127\t\n128\t\n129\tdef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n130\t    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n131\t    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n132\t    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n133\t            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n134\t        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n135\t        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n136\t        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n137\t        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n138\t\n139\t\n140\tdef preview_warnings(title_zh: str, title_en: str, rendered_zh: Rendered,\n141\t                     rendered_en: Rendered, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n142\t    \"\"\"Every warning the preview shows for a text in both languages (titles\n143\t    and rendered bodies), each labelled with where it is.\"\"\"\n144\t    return [f\"{where}：{warning}\" for where, warnings in [\n145\t                (\"中文标题\", title_warnings(title_zh, \"zh\", glossary)),\n146\t                (\"中文正文\", rendered_zh.warnings),\n147\t                (\"英文标题\", title_warnings(title_en, \"en\", glossary)),\n148\t                (\"英文正文\", rendered_en.warnings)]\n149\t            for warning in warnings]\n150\t\n151\t\n152\tdef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n153\t    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n154\t    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n155\t    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n156\t    parser = _Pieces()\n157\t    parser.feed(html)\n158\t    parser.close()\n159\t    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n160\t    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n161\t        if is_text:\n162\t            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n163\t        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n164\t            code += 1\n165\t        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n166\t            code -= 1\n167\t        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n168\t            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n169\t        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n170\t            spans.pop()\n171\t    return \"\".join(out)\n172\t\n173\t\n174\tclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n175\t    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n176\t    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n177\t\n178\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n179\t        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n180\t        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n181\t\n182\t    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n183\t        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n184\t\n185\t    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n186\t\n187\t    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n188\t        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n189\t\n190\t    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n191\t        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n192\t\n193\t\n194\t# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n195\t# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n196\t_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n197\t_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n198\t\n199\t\n200\tdef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n201\t    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n202\t    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n203\t    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n204\t    out, done = [], 0\n205\t    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n206\t        end = done + len(list(run))\n207\t        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n208\t        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n209\t                   else piece)\n210\t        done = end\n211\t    return \"\".join(out)\n212\t\n213\t\n214\tdef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n215\t              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n216\t    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n217\t    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n218\t    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n219\t    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n220\t    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n221\t    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n222\t    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n223\t    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n224\t    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n225\t    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n226\t    # characters of a quote.\n227\t    patterns = [(quote, level,\n228\t                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n229\t                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n230\t                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n231\t    if not patterns:\n232\t        return html, set()\n233\t    parser = _Pieces()\n234\t    parser.feed(html)\n235\t    parser.close()\n236\t    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n237\t    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n238\t    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n239\t        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n240\t            found.add(quote)\n241\t            for i in range(*match.span()):\n242\t                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n243\t    out, offset = [], 0\n244\t    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n245\t        if is_text:\n246\t            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n247\t            offset += len(piece)\n248\t        else:\n249\t            out.append(piece)\n250\t    return \"\".join(out), found\n251\t"}]},"uuid":"ec766b7b-683a-4e2e-a58d-a5b6155b84de","timestamp":"2026-10-18T04:19:07.391Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/rendering.py","content":"\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\nthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\nOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\nin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\nwritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\npreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\nnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\nanything.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\nfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n\nfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n\n_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n\n\ndef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n    if not matches:\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n        return None\n    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n                          for term in matches)\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n    return name\n\n\ndef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n    if not match:\n        return False\n    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n    state.pos = match.end()\n    return True\n\n\nclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n        token = tokens[idx]\n        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n            return escape(token.content)\n        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n\n    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n            options, env)\n\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rendered:\n    html: str\n    warnings: list[str]\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n\n\ndef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n\n\ndef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n\n\ndef preview_warnings(title_zh: str, title_en: str, rendered_zh: Rendered,\n                     rendered_en: Rendered, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every warning the preview shows for a text in both languages (titles\n    and rendered bodies), each labelled with where it is.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"{where}：{warning}\" for where, warnings in [\n                (\"中文标题\", title_warnings(title_zh, \"zh\", glossary)),\n                (\"中文正文\", rendered_zh.warnings),\n                (\"英文标题\", title_warnings(title_en, \"en\", glossary)),\n                (\"英文正文\", rendered_en.warnings)]\n            for warning in warnings]\n\n\ndef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n            code += 1\n        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n            code -= 1\n        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n            spans.pop()\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\nclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n\n\n# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = [(quote, level,\n                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n            found.add(quote)\n            for i in range(*match.span()):\n                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n    out, offset = [], 0\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n            offset += len(piece)\n        else:\n            out.append(piece)\n    return \"\".join(out), found\n","numLines":251,"startLine":1,"totalLines":251}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"537da1f3-96ef-4280-8404-2e1df7b4d8dc","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","hash":"0a8ed708222c9342d9ef17333978c1a2a574af0678df19e67b232e944d02d869","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ca46PNXL73axcqE4Utf7ZJ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n2\t\n3\tA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\n4\tSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\n5\tDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\n6\tGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\n7\teither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n8\t\n9\tAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\n10\tits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\n11\tGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\n12\tGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\n13\tdirectly.\n14\t\n15\tA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\n16\tchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\n17\tedit it.\n18\t\n19\tEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\n20\texist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n21\t\n22\tDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\n23\tTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n24\t\"\"\"\n25\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n26\t\n27\timport re\n28\timport sqlite3\n29\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\n30\tfrom typing import ClassVar\n31\tfrom itertools import groupby\n32\t\n33\tfrom app import db, game\n34\tfrom app.accounts import SUBMISSION_BANNED, User\n35\tfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tclass Refused(Exception):\n39\t    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n40\t\n41\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n42\t        super().__init__(message)\n43\t        self.message = message\n44\t\n45\t\n46\tclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n47\t    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n51\t    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n52\t\n53\t    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n54\t        super().__init__(message)\n55\t\n56\t\n57\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n58\t\n59\t\n60\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n61\tclass Guide:\n62\t    id: int\n63\t    slug: str\n64\t    title_zh: str\n65\t    body_zh: str\n66\t    title_en: str\n67\t    body_en: str\n68\t    hero_id: int\n69\t    hero_name_zh: str\n70\t    hero_name_en: str\n71\t    hero_slug: str\n72\t    patch_id: int\n73\t    patch_name: str\n74\t    author_id: int\n75\t    author_name: str\n76\t    status: str\n77\t    created_at: str\n78\t    updated_at: str\n79\t    published_at: str | None\n80\t    trashed_at: str | None\n81\t    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n82\t    revision_status: str | None  # the open Revision's status, if there is one\n83\t    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = False\n84\t\n85\t    @property\n86\t    def status_label(self) -> str:\n87\t        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n88\t\n89\t    @property\n90\t    def console_path(self) -> str:\n91\t        \"\"\"Where the Guide's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n92\t        return f\"admin/guides/{self.id}\"\n93\t\n94\t    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n95\t        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n96\t        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n97\t\n98\t\n99\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n100\tclass GuideFields:\n101\t    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n102\t    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n103\t    title_zh: str = \"\"\n104\t    body_zh: str = \"\"\n105\t    title_en: str = \"\"\n106\t    body_en: str = \"\"\n107\t    hero_id: int | None = None\n108\t    patch_id: int | None = None\n109\t    slug: str | None = None\n110\t\n111\t    @classmethod\n112\t    def of(cls, guide: Guide | Revision) -> GuideFields:\n113\t        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n114\t                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n115\t                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n116\t\n117\t\n118\t_SELECT = \"\"\"\n119\tSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n120\t       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n121\t       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n122\t         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id\n123\t           AND review_rounds.revision_id IS NULL)) AS returned,\n124\t       (SELECT status FROM revisions WHERE revisions.guide_id = guides.id)\n125\t         AS revision_status\n126\tFROM guides\n127\tJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\n128\tJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\n129\tJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n130\t\"\"\"\n131\t\n132\t\n133\t_NOT_TRASHED = \"guides.trashed_at IS NULL\"\n134\t\n135\t\n136\tdef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n137\t    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Guide)}\n138\t    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n139\t    return Guide(**fields)\n140\t\n141\t\n142\tdef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n143\t    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see (none in\n144\t    the Trash).\"\"\"\n145\t    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n146\t        return _NOT_TRASHED, ()\n147\t    return f\"guides.author_id = ? AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (actor.id,)\n148\t\n149\t\n150\tdef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n151\t    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n152\t    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n153\t    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n154\t                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n155\t    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n156\t\n157\t\n158\tLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n159\t\n160\t\n161\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n162\tclass GuideFilter:\n163\t    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n164\t    status: str = \"\"\n165\t    hero_id: int | None = None\n166\t    author_id: int | None = None\n167\t    patch_id: int | None = None\n168\t    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n169\t\n170\t\n171\tdef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n172\t           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n173\t    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n174\t    first.\"\"\"\n175\t    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n176\t    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n177\t    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n178\t                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n179\t                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n180\t                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n181\t        if value is not None:\n182\t            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n183\t            values.append(value)\n184\t    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n185\t    if filters.language == \"en\":\n186\t        clauses.append(has_english)\n187\t    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n188\t        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n189\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n190\t                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n191\t                        values).fetchall()\n192\t    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n193\t\n194\t\n195\tdef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n196\t    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n197\t    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n198\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published' AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n199\t                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n200\t    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n201\t\n202\t\n203\tdef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n204\t    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n205\t    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n206\t    rows = conn.execute(\n207\t        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n208\t        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n209\t        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n210\t    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n211\t\n212\t\n213\tdef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n214\t                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n215\t    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n216\t    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n217\t    patches = game.patches(conn)\n218\t    choices = patches[:3]\n219\t    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n220\t        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n221\t    return choices\n222\t\n223\t\n224\tdef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n225\t                            guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n226\t                            ) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n227\t    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n228\t    if hero is None:\n229\t        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n230\t    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n231\t    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n232\t                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n233\t        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n234\t    return hero, patch_id\n235\t\n236\t\n237\tdef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n238\t    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n239\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n240\t    cur = conn.execute(\n241\t        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n242\t        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n243\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n244\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n245\t    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n246\t    assert guide_id is not None\n247\t    slug, n = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", 1\n248\t    # Only if an Admin already gave that slug to another Guide.\n249\t    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n250\t        n += 1\n251\t        slug = f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}-{n}\"\n252\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))\n253\t    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n254\t    assert new is not None\n255\t    return new\n256\t\n257\t\n258\tdef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n259\t    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n260\t    if found is None:\n261\t        raise GuideNotFound\n262\t    return found\n263\t\n264\t\n265\t# A Guide's or a Page's slug: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, in\n266\t# hyphenated runs.\n267\tSLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n268\t\n269\t\n270\tdef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n271\t                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n272\t    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n273\t    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n274\t        return current.slug\n275\t    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n276\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n277\t    slug = slug.strip()\n278\t    if not SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n279\t        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n280\t    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n281\t                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n282\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n283\t    return slug\n284\t\n285\t\n286\tdef can_edit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n287\t    \"\"\"Whether `actor` edits `guide` itself. Admins edit any Guide they see;\n288\t    an Editor's Published Guide changes only through a Revision.\"\"\"\n289\t    return guide.status != \"published\" or actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\")\n290\t\n291\t\n292\tdef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n293\t         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n294\t    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n295\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n296\t    if not can_edit(actor, current):\n297\t        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n298\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n299\t    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n300\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n301\t        _check_text(fields)\n302\t    conn.execute(\n303\t        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n304\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n305\t        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n306\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n307\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n308\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n309\t\n310\t\n311\tdef _check_text(fields: GuideFields | Guide | Revision) -> None:\n312\t    \"\"\"The text a Guide needs before it can be reviewed or Published.\"\"\"\n313\t    if not fields.title_zh.strip() or not fields.body_zh.strip():\n314\t        raise Refused(\"提交审核前请填写中文标题和正文。\")\n315\t    if bool(fields.title_en.strip()) != bool(fields.body_en.strip()):\n316\t        raise Refused(\"英文版需要同时填写标题和正文；不写英文版就都留空。\")\n317\t\n318\t\n319\tdef _check_not_banned(actor: User) -> None:\n320\t    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\n321\t        raise NotAllowed(SUBMISSION_BANNED)\n322\t\n323\t\n324\tdef can_submit(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n325\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Submit button (提交审核) on `guide`. Admins\n326\t    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n327\t    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n328\t            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n329\t\n330\t\n331\tdef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n332\t    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n333\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n334\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n335\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n336\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n337\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n338\t                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n339\t    _check_not_banned(actor)\n340\t    _check_text(current)\n341\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n342\t                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n343\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n344\t\n345\t\n346\tdef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n347\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the Publish button (发布) on `guide`: Admins\n348\t    Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts without Submitting.\"\"\"\n349\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and (\n350\t        guide.status == \"submitted\"\n351\t        or (guide.status == \"draft\" and guide.author_id == actor.id))\n352\t\n353\t\n354\tdef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n355\t    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Guide. It reaches Readers at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n356\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n357\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n358\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布攻略。\")\n359\t    if current.status == \"published\":\n360\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n361\t    if not can_publish(actor, current):\n362\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n363\t    _check_text(current)\n364\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'published',\"\n365\t                 f\" published_at = {db.NOW}, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n366\t                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n367\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n368\t\n369\t\n370\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n371\tclass ReviewNote:\n372\t    \"\"\"A passage quoted from a Guide's text, with an Admin's advice on it.\"\"\"\n373\t    quote: str\n374\t    advice: str\n375\t\n376\t\n377\tROUND_LABELS = {\"return\": \"退回\", \"unpublish\": \"撤下\"}\n378\t\n379\t\n380\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n381\tclass ReviewRound:\n382\t    \"\"\"One Return or Unpublish (of a Guide) or Return (of a Revision), with\n383\t    the Review notes the Admin gave.\"\"\"\n384\t    kind: str\n385\t    of_revision: bool\n386\t    admin_name: str\n387\t    created_at: str\n388\t    notes: tuple[ReviewNote, ...]\n389\t\n390\t    @property\n391\t    def label(self) -> str:\n392\t        return \"退回修订\" if self.of_revision else ROUND_LABELS[self.kind]\n393\t\n394\t\n395\tdef review_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n396\t                  guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n397\t    \"\"\"Every Return and Unpublish of a Guide `actor` may see, and the Returns\n398\t    of its Revisions that are no longer open, newest first.\"\"\"\n399\t    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n400\t    return _rounds(conn, \"guide_id = ? AND (revision_id IS NULL\"\n401\t                   \" OR revision_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM revisions))\", (guide_id,))\n402\t\n403\t\n404\tdef revision_rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n405\t                    guide_id: int) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n406\t    \"\"\"Every Return of the Guide's open Revision, newest first.\"\"\"\n407\t    _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n408\t    return _rounds(conn, \"revision_id = (SELECT id FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?)\",\n409\t                   (guide_id,))\n410\t\n411\t\n412\tdef _rounds(conn: sqlite3.Connection, where: str,\n413\t            params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[ReviewRound]:\n414\t    rows = conn.execute(\n415\t        \"SELECT review_rounds.id, kind, revision_id, review_rounds.created_at,\"\n416\t        \" users.display_name AS admin_name, quote, advice FROM review_rounds\"\n417\t        \" JOIN users ON users.id = review_rounds.admin_id\"\n418\t        \" LEFT JOIN review_notes ON review_notes.round_id = review_rounds.id\"\n419\t        f\" WHERE {where} ORDER BY review_rounds.id DESC, review_notes.id\",\n420\t        params).fetchall()\n421\t    rounds = []\n422\t    for _, group in groupby(rows, key=lambda row: row[\"id\"]):\n423\t        group = list(group)\n424\t        # A round with no notes (an Unpublish may have none) has one row,\n425\t        # whose note columns are NULL.\n426\t        notes = tuple(ReviewNote(row[\"quote\"], row[\"advice\"])\n427\t                      for row in group if row[\"quote\"] is not None)\n428\t        rounds.append(ReviewRound(kind=group[0][\"kind\"],\n429\t                                  of_revision=group[0][\"revision_id\"] is not None,\n430\t                                  admin_name=group[0][\"admin_name\"],\n431\t                                  created_at=group[0][\"created_at\"], notes=notes))\n432\t    return rounds\n433\t\n434\t\n435\tdef can_review(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n436\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the review screen for `guide`: Admins Return\n437\t    (or Publish) a Submitted Guide and Unpublish a Published one.\"\"\"\n438\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\")\n439\t\n440\t\n441\tdef quotes_to_highlight(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n442\t                        item: Guide | Revision) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n443\t    \"\"\"The passages quoted by the latest review round's Review notes, and\n444\t    those quoted only by earlier rounds. The preview highlights both, set\n445\t    apart, wherever they are still in the text, until the Guide is Published\n446\t    again. A Revision has rounds of its own; a Guide's leave out those of its\n447\t    past Revisions, which quoted the Revision's text.\"\"\"\n448\t    if isinstance(item, Revision):\n449\t        rounds = revision_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n450\t    elif item.status == \"published\":\n451\t        return [], []\n452\t    else:\n453\t        rounds = [round for round in review_rounds(conn, actor, item.id)\n454\t                  if not round.of_revision]\n455\t    if not rounds:\n456\t        return [], []\n457\t    latest = list(dict.fromkeys(note.quote for note in rounds[0].notes))\n458\t    earlier = [quote for quote in dict.fromkeys(\n459\t        note.quote for round in rounds[1:] for note in round.notes)\n460\t        if quote not in latest]\n461\t    return latest, earlier\n462\t\n463\t\n464\tdef _checked_notes(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision,\n465\t                   notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> list[ReviewNote]:\n466\t    \"\"\"The notes, trimmed. Each quotes a passage of the Guide's text as the\n467\t    preview shows it, so the Author will see it highlighted there.\"\"\"\n468\t    notes = [ReviewNote(note.quote.strip(), note.advice.strip()) for note in notes]\n469\t    if any(not note.quote or not note.advice for note in notes):\n470\t        raise Refused(\"每条审核意见都要有引用的段落和修改建议。\")\n471\t    quotes = [note.quote for note in notes]\n472\t    glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n473\t    found = (highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_zh, \"zh\", glossary).html, quotes)[1]\n474\t             | highlight(render_markdown(guide.body_en, \"en\", glossary).html, quotes)[1])\n475\t    for quote in quotes:\n476\t        if quote not in found:\n477\t            raise Refused(f\"在攻略正文中找不到引用的段落“{quote}”。\"\n478\t                          \"请从上面的正文中复制原文。\")\n479\t    return notes\n480\t\n481\t\n482\tdef _send_back(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide, kind: str,\n483\t               notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n484\t    \"\"\"Turn the Guide back into a Draft for its Author, recording the round.\n485\t    The status it was read in is checked again as it changes, so if another\n486\t    Admin got there first this is refused rather than undoing their step.\"\"\"\n487\t    changed = conn.execute(\n488\t        f\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n489\t        \" WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\", (current.id, current.status)).rowcount\n490\t    if not changed:\n491\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n492\t    _record_round(conn, actor, current.id, kind, notes)\n493\t    return _editable(conn, actor, current.id)\n494\t\n495\t\n496\tdef _record_round(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int, kind: str,\n497\t                  notes: list[ReviewNote], revision_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n498\t    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO review_rounds (guide_id, revision_id, admin_id,\"\n499\t                       \" kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n500\t                       (guide_id, revision_id, actor.id, kind))\n501\t    conn.executemany(\"INSERT INTO review_notes (round_id, quote, advice)\"\n502\t                     \" VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n503\t                     [(cur.lastrowid, note.quote, note.advice) for note in notes])\n504\t\n505\t\n506\tdef return_guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n507\t                 notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n508\t    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Guide back to its Author as a Draft, with at\n509\t    least one Review note saying what to fix.\"\"\"\n510\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n511\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n512\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回攻略。\")\n513\t    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n514\t        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的攻略。\")\n515\t    notes = _checked_notes(conn, current, notes)\n516\t    if not notes:\n517\t        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n518\t    return _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"return\", notes)\n519\t\n520\t\n521\tdef unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n522\t              notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Guide:\n523\t    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Published Guide off the site at the next Site build.\n524\t    It goes back to its Author as a Draft, with Review notes if any. An open\n525\t    Revision is kept, but back as a Draft: there is nothing for it to change\n526\t    until the Guide is Published again.\"\"\"\n527\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n528\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n529\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以撤下攻略。\")\n530\t    if current.status != \"published\":\n531\t        raise Refused(\"只能撤下已发布的攻略。\")\n532\t    unpublished = _send_back(conn, actor, current, \"unpublish\",\n533\t                             _checked_notes(conn, current, notes))\n534\t    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n535\t                 \" WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted'\", (guide_id,))\n536\t    return unpublished\n537\t\n538\t\n539\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n540\tclass Revision:\n541\t    \"\"\"A pending change to a Published Guide: its own copy of the texts, Hero\n542\t    and Patch, with its own status (Draft or Submitted). It has the Guide's\n543\t    slug and Author, and reads like a Guide wherever a page shows one.\"\"\"\n544\t    guide: Guide\n545\t    title_zh: str\n546\t    body_zh: str\n547\t    title_en: str\n548\t    body_en: str\n549\t    hero_id: int\n550\t    hero_name_zh: str\n551\t    hero_name_en: str\n552\t    hero_slug: str\n553\t    patch_id: int\n554\t    patch_name: str\n555\t    status: str\n556\t    base_updated_at: str  # the Guide's updated_at when this was opened\n557\t    created_at: str\n558\t    updated_at: str\n559\t    returned: bool  # a Draft that an Admin Returned\n560\t    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = True\n561\t\n562\t    @property\n563\t    def guide_changed_since(self) -> bool:\n564\t        \"\"\"Whether the Guide changed after this was opened (an Admin's edit,\n565\t        an Unpublish), so that Publishing this would undo that change.\"\"\"\n566\t        return self.guide.updated_at != self.base_updated_at\n567\t\n568\t    @property\n569\t    def id(self) -> int:\n570\t        return self.guide.id\n571\t\n572\t    @property\n573\t    def slug(self) -> str:\n574\t        return self.guide.slug\n575\t\n576\t    @property\n577\t    def author_id(self) -> int:\n578\t        return self.guide.author_id\n579\t\n580\t    @property\n581\t    def author_name(self) -> str:\n582\t        return self.guide.author_name\n583\t\n584\t    @property\n585\t    def status_label(self) -> str:\n586\t        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n587\t\n588\t    @property\n589\t    def console_path(self) -> str:\n590\t        return f\"{self.guide.console_path}/revision\"\n591\t\n592\t\n593\t_REVISION_SELECT = \"\"\"\n594\tSELECT revisions.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n595\t       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name,\n596\t       (revisions.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n597\t         WHERE review_rounds.revision_id = revisions.id)) AS returned\n598\tFROM revisions\n599\tJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = revisions.hero_id\n600\tJOIN patches ON patches.id = revisions.patch_id\n601\t\"\"\"\n602\t\n603\t\n604\tdef revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision | None:\n605\t    \"\"\"The Guide's open Revision, or None if it has none or `actor` may not\n606\t    see the Guide.\"\"\"\n607\t    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n608\t    if found is None:\n609\t        return None\n610\t    row = conn.execute(f\"{_REVISION_SELECT} WHERE revisions.guide_id = ?\",\n611\t                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n612\t    if row is None:\n613\t        return None\n614\t    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Revision)\n615\t              if field.name != \"guide\"}\n616\t    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])\n617\t    return Revision(guide=found, **fields)\n618\t\n619\t\n620\tdef _open(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n621\t    found = revision(conn, actor, guide_id)\n622\t    if found is None:\n623\t        _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)  # not found at all, rather than no Revision\n624\t        raise GuideNotFound(\"这篇攻略没有打开的修订。\")\n625\t    return found\n626\t\n627\t\n628\tdef can_open_revision(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\n629\t    \"\"\"Whether to offer `actor` the 修订 button on `guide`: an Editor revises\n630\t    their own Published Guide; an Admin edits it directly instead.\"\"\"\n631\t    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"published\"\n632\t            and guide.revision_status is None and not actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"))\n633\t\n634\t\n635\tdef open_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n636\t    \"\"\"The Author starts a Revision of their Published Guide, as a Draft copy\n637\t    of its texts, Hero and Patch.\"\"\"\n638\t    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n639\t    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n640\t        raise Refused(\"管理员可以直接修改已发布的攻略，不需要修订。\")\n641\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n642\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以修订这篇攻略。\")\n643\t    if current.status != \"published\":\n644\t        raise Refused(\"只有已发布的攻略需要修订；草稿和待审核的攻略可以直接修改。\")\n645\t    _check_not_banned(actor)  # a Revision they could never Submit\n646\t    try:\n647\t        conn.execute(\n648\t            \"INSERT INTO revisions (guide_id, base_updated_at, title_zh, body_zh,\"\n649\t            \" title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id) SELECT id, updated_at, title_zh,\"\n650\t            \" body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id, patch_id FROM guides WHERE id = ?\",\n651\t            (guide_id,))\n652\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:  # the Guide already has one\n653\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经有一份修订了，请继续修改那一份。\") from None\n654\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n655\t\n656\t\n657\tdef save_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n658\t                  fields: GuideFields) -> Revision:\n659\t    \"\"\"Save changes to the open Revision without changing its status. The\n660\t    slug is the Guide's and stays as it is.\"\"\"\n661\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n662\t    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n663\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n664\t        _check_text(fields)\n665\t    conn.execute(\n666\t        \"UPDATE revisions SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n667\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\",\n668\t        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n669\t         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, guide_id))\n670\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n671\t\n672\t\n673\tdef can_submit_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n674\t    return (revision.author_id == actor.id and revision.status == \"draft\"\n675\t            and revision.guide.status == \"published\")\n676\t\n677\t\n678\tdef submit_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n679\t    \"\"\"The Author marks their Revision finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n680\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n681\t    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n682\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交修订。\")\n683\t    if current.status != \"draft\":\n684\t        raise Refused(\"这份修订已经提交审核了。\")\n685\t    if current.guide.status != \"published\":\n686\t        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已被撤下。修订只能在攻略重新发布后提交；\"\n687\t                      \"也可以直接修改攻略草稿。\")\n688\t    _check_not_banned(actor)\n689\t    _check_text(current)\n690\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'submitted',\"\n691\t                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n692\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n693\t\n694\t\n695\tdef can_discard_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n696\t    return revision.author_id == actor.id\n697\t\n698\t\n699\tdef discard_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n700\t    \"\"\"The Author throws their open Revision away, so they can open a new one\n701\t    later. The Published Guide is untouched; Returns of the Revision stay in\n702\t    its history.\"\"\"\n703\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n704\t    if not can_discard_revision(actor, current):\n705\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以放弃修订。\")\n706\t    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n707\t\n708\t\n709\tdef can_publish_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n710\t    return actor.can(\"publish_guides\") and revision.status == \"submitted\"\n711\t\n712\t\n713\tdef publish_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n714\t    \"\"\"An Admin approves a Revision: it replaces the Guide's texts, Hero and\n715\t    Patch (the old ones are not kept) and is gone. The slug stays, and the\n716\t    Guide's 更新于 date moves on. Readers see it at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n717\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n718\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n719\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以发布修订。\")\n720\t    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n721\t        raise Refused(\"这份修订还是草稿，要等作者提交审核后才能发布。\")\n722\t    _check_text(current)\n723\t    # Checked again as it is deleted, so a Revision another Admin Returned\n724\t    # meanwhile is refused rather than Published.\n725\t    if not conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM revisions WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted'\",\n726\t                        (guide_id,)).rowcount:\n727\t        raise Refused(\"这份修订刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n728\t    conn.execute(\n729\t        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n730\t        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\",\n731\t        (current.title_zh, current.body_zh, current.title_en, current.body_en,\n732\t         current.hero_id, current.patch_id, guide_id))\n733\t    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n734\t\n735\t\n736\tdef return_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n737\t                    notes: list[ReviewNote]) -> Revision:\n738\t    \"\"\"An Admin sends a Submitted Revision back to its Author as a Draft,\n739\t    with at least one Review note. The Published Guide stays as it is.\"\"\"\n740\t    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n741\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n742\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以退回修订。\")\n743\t    if current.status != \"submitted\":\n744\t        raise Refused(\"只能退回待审核的修订。\")\n745\t    notes = _checked_notes(conn, current, notes)\n746\t    if not notes:\n747\t        raise Refused(\"退回时请至少写一条审核意见。\")\n748\t    row = conn.execute(f\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'draft', updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n749\t                       \" WHERE guide_id = ? AND status = 'submitted' RETURNING id\",\n750\t                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n751\t    if row is None:  # another Admin got there first\n752\t        raise Refused(\"这份修订刚被别人改过，请刷新页面后再试。\")\n753\t    _record_round(conn, actor, guide_id, \"return\", notes, revision_id=row[\"id\"])\n754\t    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n755\t\n756\t\n757\tdef _revisions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, where: str,\n758\t               params: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[Revision]:\n759\t    \"\"\"The open Revisions matching `where`, of Guides `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n760\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT guide_id FROM revisions WHERE {where}\", params)\n761\t    found = [revision(conn, actor, row[\"guide_id\"]) for row in rows.fetchall()]\n762\t    return [item for item in found if item is not None]\n763\t\n764\t\n765\tdef delete(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n766\t    \"\"\"Move a Guide, in whatever status and with any open Revision, to the\n767\t    Trash. Anyone who can see a Guide can delete it: an Editor their own, an\n768\t    Admin any. A Published one leaves the site at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n769\t    _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n770\t    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE guides SET trashed_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n771\t\n772\t\n773\tdef trashed(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n774\t    \"\"\"Every Guide in the Trash, most recently deleted first. Admins only.\"\"\"\n775\t    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n776\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以查看回收站。\")\n777\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n778\t                        \" ORDER BY guides.trashed_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n779\t    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n780\t\n781\t\n782\tdef in_trash(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n783\t    \"\"\"The Guide, if it is in the Trash. Admins only.\"\"\"\n784\t    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n785\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以查看回收站。\")\n786\t    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\",\n787\t                       (guide_id,)).fetchone()\n788\t    if row is None:\n789\t        raise GuideNotFound(\"回收站里没有这篇攻略。\")\n790\t    return _guide_from_row(row)\n791\t\n792\t\n793\tdef restore(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n794\t    \"\"\"An Admin takes a Guide out of the Trash. Its status, texts, Review\n795\t    notes and open Revision never changed there, so it is back as it was.\"\"\"\n796\t    if not actor.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n797\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以从回收站恢复攻略。\")\n798\t    if not conn.execute(f\"UPDATE guides SET trashed_at = NULL, restored_at = {db.NOW}\"\n799\t                        f\" WHERE id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (guide_id,)).rowcount:\n800\t        raise GuideNotFound(\"回收站里没有这篇攻略。\")\n801\t\n802\t\n803\tdef delete_for_good(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n804\t    \"\"\"An Admin deletes a Guide in the Trash for good, with its Review notes\n805\t    and any open Revision. It cannot be restored.\"\"\"\n806\t    if in_trash(conn, actor, guide_id).status == \"published\":\n807\t        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO removed_guides (guide_id) VALUES (?)\", (guide_id,))\n808\t    conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM guides WHERE id = ? AND NOT {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (guide_id,))\n809\t\n810\t\n811\tdef trash_changes_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n812\t    \"\"\"The ids of Published Guides moved to the Trash, restored from it, or\n813\t    deleted from it for good after `since`: the next Site build drops or adds\n814\t    them. It may count one the site never had (or already lacks), such as a\n815\t    Guide deleted and restored in between, but never misses one.\"\"\"\n816\t    rows = conn.execute(\n817\t        \"SELECT id FROM guides WHERE status = 'published'\"\n818\t        \" AND (trashed_at > ? OR (trashed_at IS NULL AND restored_at > ?))\"\n819\t        \" UNION SELECT guide_id FROM removed_guides WHERE removed_at > ?\",\n820\t        (since, since, since)).fetchall()\n821\t    return {row[0] for row in rows}\n822\t\n823\t\n824\tdef unpublished_since(conn: sqlite3.Connection, since: str) -> set[int]:\n825\t    \"\"\"The ids of Guides Unpublished after `since` and not Published again:\n826\t    the Site build reads Published Guides only, so they drop out of it.\"\"\"\n827\t    rows = conn.execute(\n828\t        \"SELECT DISTINCT guide_id FROM review_rounds JOIN guides\"\n829\t        \" ON guides.id = review_rounds.guide_id WHERE kind = 'unpublish'\"\n830\t        \" AND review_rounds.created_at > ? AND guides.status != 'published'\",\n831\t        (since,)).fetchall()\n832\t    return {row[\"guide_id\"] for row in rows}\n833\t\n834\t\n835\tdef review_queue(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide | Revision]:\n836\t    \"\"\"Every Submitted Guide and Revision waiting for an Admin, longest\n837\t    waiting first (as far as the last change shows); nothing for anyone who\n838\t    can't review.\"\"\"\n839\t    if not actor.can(\"publish_guides\"):\n840\t        return []\n841\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'submitted'\"\n842\t                        f\" AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\").fetchall()\n843\t    queue = [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n844\t    queue += _revisions(conn, actor, \"status = 'submitted'\", ())\n845\t    return sorted(queue, key=lambda item: (item.updated_at, item.id))\n846\t\n847\t\n848\tdef returned_to(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide | Revision]:\n849\t    \"\"\"`actor`'s own Guides and Revisions that an Admin sent back to them and\n850\t    that they have not Submitted again, most recently sent back first.\"\"\"\n851\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.author_id = ? Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n9\t     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n10\t\n11\tA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\n12\tdeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. }\n37\t.site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 1rem; flex-basis: 100%; }\n38\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n39\t.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 .5rem; border-radius: 1rem;\n40\t         border: 1px solid; font-size: .85em; }\n41\t.term { font-weight: 600; }\n42\t.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n43\t.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n44\t\"\"\"\n45\t\n46\tLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n47\t\n48\t# The words on the public site, in each language.\n49\tLABELS = {\n50\t    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"English\"},\n56\t    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n57\t           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n58\t environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n71\t    env = Environment(\n72\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n73\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n74\t    )\n75\t    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n76\t    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n92\t    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n93\t    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n94\t    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n95\t    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n96\t    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n97\t        link += \"/\"\n98\t    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n99\t\n100\t\n101\tclass _Writer:\n102\t    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. self.nav_pages = {lang: [page for page in nav_pages if page.has_text_in(lang)]\n115\t                          for lang in LANGUAGES}\n116\t\n117\t    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: published = guides.published(conn)\n144\t        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n145\t        patches = game.patches(conn)\n146\t        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n147\t        pages =
