Raises DeployFailed if the push\n227\t    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n228\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n229\t        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n230\t    out = render_site()\n231\t    deploy(out)\n232\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n233\t        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n234\t    return out\n235\t\n236\t\n237\tdef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n238\t    \"\"\"How many Guides, Pages and Tournament items changed since the last\n239\t    successful Site build started (all of them, if there has never been\n240\t    one): Published Guides edited since, Guides Unpublished since, which the\n241\t    next build leaves out, Published Guides moved to or restored from the\n242\t    Trash since, and the Page and Tournament changes content.changes_since\n243\t    counts.\"\"\"\n244\t    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n245\t    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n246\t    return (len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n247\t                | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n248\t            + content.changes_since(conn, last))\n249\t"},{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01415PN4RQHa1XhMAj5pWLiS","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\n2\tthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\n3\tthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n4\t\n5\tA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\n6\tOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\n7\tin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\n8\twritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\n9\tpreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\n10\tnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\n11\tanything.\n12\t\n13\tWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\n14\twith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\n15\thandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\n16\tsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\n17\tfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n18\t\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\timport re\n22\tfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\n23\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n24\tfrom html import escape\n25\tfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n26\tfrom itertools import groupby\n27\t\n28\timport nh3\n29\tfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n30\tfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\n31\tfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\n32\tfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n33\tfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n34\t\n35\tfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n36\t\n37\t_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n38\t\n39\t\n40\tdef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n41\t    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n42\t    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n43\t    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n44\t    if not matches:\n45\t        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n46\t                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n47\t        return None\n48\t    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n49\t    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n50\t        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n51\t                          for term in matches)\n52\t        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n53\t                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n54\t    return name\n55\t\n56\t\n57\tdef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n58\t    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n59\t    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n60\t    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n61\t    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n62\t    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n63\t    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n64\t    if not match:\n65\t        return False\n66\t    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n67\t    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n68\t    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n69\t    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n70\t    state.pos = match.end()\n71\t    return True\n72\t\n73\t\n74\tclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n75\t    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n76\t                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n77\t        token = tokens[idx]\n78\t        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n79\t            return escape(token.content)\n80\t        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n81\t\n82\t    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n83\t                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n84\t        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n85\t        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n86\t            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n87\t             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n88\t            options, env)\n89\t\n90\t\n91\t_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n92\t                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n93\t_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n94\t\n95\t\n96\tdef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n97\t    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n98\t    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n99\t        return None\n100\t    return value\n101\t\n102\t\n103\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n104\tclass Rendered:\n105\t    html: str\n106\t    warnings: list[str]\n107\t\n108\t\n109\tdef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n110\t    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n111\t    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n112\t    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n113\t    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n114\t                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n115\t                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n116\t    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n117\t    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n118\t\n119\t\n120\tdef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n121\t    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n122\t    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n123\t    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n124\t            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n125\t            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n126\t            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n127\t\n128\t\n129\tdef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n130\t    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n131\t    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n132\t    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n133\t            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n134\t        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n135\t        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n136\t        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n137\t        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n138\t\n139\t\n140\tdef preview_warnings(title_zh: str, title_en: str, rendered_zh: Rendered,\n141\t                     rendered_en: Rendered, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n142\t    \"\"\"Every warning the preview shows for a text in both languages (titles\n143\t    and rendered bodies), each labelled with where it is.\"\"\"\n144\t    return [f\"{where}：{warning}\" for where, warnings in [\n145\t                (\"中文标题\", title_warnings(title_zh, \"zh\", glossary)),\n146\t                (\"中文正文\", rendered_zh.warnings),\n147\t                (\"英文标题\", title_warnings(title_en, \"en\", glossary)),\n148\t                (\"英文正文\", rendered_en.warnings)]\n149\t            for warning in warnings]\n150\t\n151\t\n152\tdef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n153\t    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n154\t    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n155\t    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n156\t    parser = _Pieces()\n157\t    parser.feed(html)\n158\t    parser.close()\n159\t    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n160\t    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n161\t        if is_text:\n162\t            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n163\t        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n164\t            code += 1\n165\t        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n166\t            code -= 1\n167\t        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n168\t            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n169\t        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n170\t            spans.pop()\n171\t    return \"\".join(out)\n172\t\n173\t\n174\tclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n175\t    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n176\t    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n177\t\n178\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n179\t        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n180\t        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n181\t\n182\t    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n183\t        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n184\t\n185\t    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n186\t\n187\t    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n188\t        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n189\t\n190\t    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n191\t        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n192\t\n193\t\n194\t# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n195\t# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n196\t_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n197\t_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n198\t\n199\t\n200\tdef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n201\t    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n202\t    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n203\t    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n204\t    out, done = [], 0\n205\t    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n206\t        end = done + len(list(run))\n207\t        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n208\t        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n209\t                   else piece)\n210\t        done = end\n211\t    return \"\".join(out)\n212\t\n213\t\n214\tdef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n215\t              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n216\t    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n217\t    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n218\t    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n219\t    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n220\t    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n221\t    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n222\t    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n223\t    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n224\t    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n225\t    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n226\t    # characters of a quote.\n227\t    patterns = [(quote, level,\n228\t                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n229\t                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n230\t                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n231\t    if not patterns:\n232\t        return html, set()\n233\t    parser = _Pieces()\n234\t    parser.feed(html)\n235\t    parser.close()\n236\t    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n237\t    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n238\t    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n239\t        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n240\t            found.add(quote)\n241\t            for i in range(*match.span()):\n242\t                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n243\t    out, offset = [], 0\n244\t    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n245\t        if is_text:\n246\t            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n247\t            offset += len(piece)\n248\t        else:\n249\t            out.append(piece)\n250\t    return \"\".join(out), found\n251\t"}]}}

 {% if quotes %}\n  <p>各轮审核意见引用的段落已用高亮标出（只在这里显示，读者看不到）：<mark>最近一轮</mark>{% if earlier %} · <mark class=\"earlier\">更早几轮</mark>{% endif %}。{% for quote in quotes if quote not in found %}{% if  </form>\n  <p>还不行的话，写下审核意见退回给作者：</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if guide.status in (\"submitted\", \"published\") %}\n  <hr>\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","hash":"ce0b6dbe12db7bf823854b823341e6df769192af4fdad576900f4bdc806761f5","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013Hh7JJyXog2yFS8j2rZTmE","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings, times\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text. A missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets the console's message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\n_LARGEST_ID = 2 ** 63 - 1  # SQLite's largest integer\n\n\ndef id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"A form's or query's id field as a number, or None if it holds anything\n    but ASCII digits or a number too large to be an id.\"\"\"\n    value = value.strip()\n    if not (value.isascii() and value.isdigit()):\n        return None\n    number = int(value)\n    return number if number <= _LARGEST_ID else None\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.filters.update(times.FILTERS)\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test gets its own empty SQLite database (through `CMS_DATABASE`) holding\nonly the DEMO_USERS below. The Site build writes into a temporary folder, and\nits deploy step is replaced, so no test ever pushes to gh-pages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"演示管理员\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, email=user[\"email\"],\n                                 password=user[\"password\"], role=role,\n                                 display_name=user[\"display_name\"])\n    return tmp_path / \"cms.db\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef deploys(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> list[Path]:\n    \"\"\"The folders the Site build deployed, in order. A test can replace\n    `app.publish.deploy` again to make the push fail.\"\"\"\n    from app import publish, settings\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    pushed: list[Path] = []\n    monkeypatch.setattr(publish, \"deploy\", lambda out, *_: pushed.append(out))\n    return pushed\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account directly, in any state, with its setup done\n    (quicker than making it on the Users page, which T09's tests do).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    \"\"\"Submit the login form the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        if c.get(\"/login\").status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = login(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import add_user, csrf_token, login\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        fill_in(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef choice(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the Hero or Patch picker option showing `label`.\"\"\"\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\nhero_id = patch_id = choice\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = fill_in(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef form_values(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form on `page` would send unchanged: its text inputs,\n    textareas and selected options.\"\"\"\n    values = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page))\n    values |= dict(re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page,\n                              re.DOTALL))\n    for name, options in re.findall(r'<select name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page,\n                                    re.DOTALL):\n        selected = re.search(r'<option value=\"(\\d*)\" selected', options)\n        values[name] = selected.group(1) if selected else \"\"\n    return {name: html.unescape(value) for name, value in values.items()}\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Change some fields of a saved Guide, keeping the rest as they are.\"\"\"\n    current = form_values(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    return fill_in(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **(current | fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"草稿已保存\" in page.text\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in page.text and \"先拿船，再拿炮。\" in page.text\n\n    response = save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert select: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The labels of the options in the <select> called `select`.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<select name=\"{select}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page, re.DOTALL)\n    assert match, f\"no {select} picker\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<option[^>]*>([^<]*)</option>\", match.group(1))\n\n\ndef test_hero_picker_lists_official_names_only(editor):\n    page = {"parentUuid":"5e54b4b8-9cf5-4c28-9d41-f63abc5854a8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dab45f80-42a3-444d-8092-be343cf2ed99","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013Hh7JJyXog2yFS8j2rZTmE","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings, times\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text. A missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets the console's message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\n_LARGEST_ID = 2 ** 63 - 1  # SQLite's largest integer\n\n\ndef id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"A form's or query's id field as a number, or None if it holds anything\n    but ASCII digits or a number too large to be an id.\"\"\"\n    value = value.strip()\n    if not (value.isascii() and value.isdigit()):\n        return None\n    number = int(value)\n    return number if number <= _LARGEST_ID else None\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.filters.update(times.FILTERS)\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test gets its own empty SQLite database (through `CMS_DATABASE`) holding\nonly the DEMO_USERS below. The Site build writes into a temporary folder, and\nits deploy step is replaced, so no test ever pushes to gh-pages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"演示管理员\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, email=user[\"email\"],\n                                 password=user[\"password\"], role=role,\n                                 display_name=user[\"display_name\"])\n    return tmp_path / \"cms.db\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef deploys(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> list[Path]:\n    \"\"\"The folders the Site build deployed, in order. A test can replace\n    `app.publish.deploy` again to make the push fail.\"\"\"\n    from app import publish, settings\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    pushed: list[Path] = []\n    monkeypatch.setattr(publish, \"deploy\", lambda out, *_: pushed.append(out))\n    return pushed\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account directly, in any state, with its setup done\n    (quicker than making it on the Users page, which T09's tests do).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    \"\"\"Submit the login form the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        if c.get(\"/login\").status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = login(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings, times\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text. A missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets the console's message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\n_LARGEST_ID = 2 ** 63 - 1  # SQLite's largest integer\n\n\ndef id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"A form's or query's id field as a number, or None if it holds anything\n    but ASCII digits or a number too large to be an id.\"\"\"\n    value = value.strip()\n    if not (value.isascii() and value.isdigit()):\n        return None\n    number = int(value)\n    return number if number <= _LARGEST_ID else None\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.filters.update(times.FILTERS)\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test gets its own empty SQLite database (through `CMS_DATABASE`) holding\nonly the DEMO_USERS below. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","hash":"3b50f074b643604a164d09a5610a6660e71f2260702dfbb9335690a78148c1b1","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01B3dS4uZWdx3NYScrg99Hsy","type":"tool_result","content":"    return [_page_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\n# Tournament items. An announcement (预告) tells Readers about an upcoming\n# Tournament; a recap (回顾) tells how one went, and may link to the\n# announcement it follows. Each has the Tournament's date and Patch.\n\nKIND_LABELS = {\"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentItem:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    tournament_date: str  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    announcement_id: int | None  # a recap's announcement, if it has one\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KIND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"admin/tournaments/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Tournament item form sends.\"\"\"\n    kind: str = \"announcement\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    tournament_date: str = \"\"\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    announcement_id: int | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, item: TournamentItem) -> TournamentFields:\n        return cls(kind=item.kind, title_zh=item.title_zh, body_zh=item.body_zh,\n                   title_en=item.title_en, body_en=item.body_en,\n                   tournament_date=item.tournament_date, patch_id=item.patch_id,\n                   announcement_id=item.announcement_id)\n\n\n_TOURNAMENT_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT tournament_items.*, patches.name AS patch_name FROM tournament_items\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = tournament_items.patch_id\n\"\"\"\n# Newest first: the latest Tournament date, and the one added last on a day.\n_NEWEST_FIRST = \"ORDER BY tournament_date DESC, tournament_items.id DESC\"\n\n\ndef _item_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TournamentItem:\n    return TournamentItem(**{field.name: row[field.name]\n                             for field in fields_of(TournamentItem)})\n\n\ndef _checked_tournament_fields(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: TournamentFields,\n                               item_id: int | None = None) -> TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"The fields, with the date trimmed and an announcement's link dropped.\n    Raises Refused if the kind, date or Patch is missing, or a recap links\n    to anything but another announcement.\"\"\"\n    if fields.kind not in KIND_LABELS:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择预告或回顾。\")\n    day = fields.tournament_date.strip()\n    try:\n        valid = date.fromisoformat(day).isoformat() == day\n    except ValueError:\n        valid = False\n    if not valid:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写比赛日期，例如 2026-10-24。\")\n    if fields.patch_id is None or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM patches WHERE id = ?\", (fields.patch_id,)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    announcement_id = fields.announcement_id if fields.kind == \"recap\" else None\n    if announcement_id is not None and (announcement_id == item_id or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ? AND kind = 'announcement'\",\n            (announcement_id,)).fetchone()):\n        raise Refused(\"回顾只能关联一条锦标赛预告。\")\n    return replace(_trimmed(fields), tournament_date=day,\n                   announcement_id=announcement_id)\n\n\ndef _existing_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE tournament_items.id = ?\",\n                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这条锦标赛内容。\")\n    return _item_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Tournament item, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_item_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")]\n\n\ndef create_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                           fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO tournament_items (kind, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en,\"\n        \" tournament_date, patch_id, announcement_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id))\n    return _existing_item(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef save_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int,\n                         fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Change a Tournament item. A Published one must stay publishable. An\n    announcement made a recap is no longer one, so recaps stop linking to it.\"\"\"\n    current = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields, item_id)\n    published = current.status == \"published\"\n    if published:\n        _check_publishable(fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n                           fields.body_en)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE tournament_items SET kind = ?, title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?,\"\n        \" title_en = ?, body_en = ?, tournament_date = ?, patch_id = ?,\"\n        f\" announcement_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        + (f\", site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\" if published else \"\") + \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id, item_id))\n    if published:\n        _recaps_change_with(conn, current)\n    if fields.kind != \"announcement\":\n        _unlink_recaps_of(conn, current)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef _recaps_change_with(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: TournamentItem) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When an announcement is Published, Unpublished, edited while Published\n    or deleted, each Published recap linking to it changes on the site too:\n    its link appears, goes, or shows the new title.\"\"\"\n    if item.kind == \"announcement\":\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE tournament_items SET site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                     \" WHERE announcement_id = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n                     (item.id,))\n\n\ndef _unlink_recaps_of(conn: sqlite3.Connection, announcement: TournamentItem) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Recaps that linked to the announcement stop doing so.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE tournament_items SET announcement_id = NULL\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ?\", (announcement.id,))\n\n\ndef publish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                            item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _publish(conn, \"tournament_items\", item, \"锦标赛内容\")\n    _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef unpublish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                              item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _unpublish(conn, \"tournament_items\", item, \"锦标赛内容\")\n    _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef delete_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Tournament item for good; recaps that linked to it stay, with\n    no link.\"\"\"\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    if item.status == \"published\":\n        _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item)\n    _record_removal(conn, \"tournament_item\", \"tournament_items\", item)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n\ndef published_tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Tournament item, newest first: all the Site build may\n    read.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE status = 'published' {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")\n    return [_item_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\"\"\"Tournament announcements (预告) and recaps (回顾) in the console, managed\nby Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to. Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import replace\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import content, db, game, publish\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import TournamentFields, TournamentItem\nfrom app.routes.pages import page_manager, preview_page, status_for\nfrom app.web import flash, form_text, id_or_none, redirect, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\nasync def tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    texts = {name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n             (\"kind\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\", \"tournament_date\")}\n    return TournamentFields(**texts,\n                            patch_id=id_or_none(form_text(form, \"patch_id\")),\n                            announcement_id=id_or_none(form_text(form, \"announcement_id\")))\n\n\nasync def sent_tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n    None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return await tournament_fields(request) if \"kind\" in form else None\n\n\ndef existing_item(item_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> TournamentItem:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.tournament_item(conn, user, item_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, item: TournamentItem | None,\n                fields: TournamentFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        if fields.patch_id is None and patches:  # a new item: the Current Patch\n            fields = replace(fields, patch_id=patches[0].id)\n        announcements = [other for other in content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n                         if other.kind == \"announcement\"\n                         and (item is None or other.id != item.id)]\n    title = (f\"编辑锦标赛{item.kind_label}：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if item\n             else \"新建锦标赛内容\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournament_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"item\": item, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"kinds\": content.KIND_LABELS, \"patches\": patches,\n         \"announcements\": announcements, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef tournament_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournaments.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"锦标赛\", \"user\": user, \"items\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/new\")\ndef new_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, TournamentFields())\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef create_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, An announcement (预告) tells Readers about an upcoming\n# Tournament; a recap (回顾) tells how one went, and may link to the\n# announcement it follows. Each has the Tournament's date and Patch.\n\nKIND_LABELS = {\"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentItem:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    tournament_date: str  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    announcement_id: int | None  # a recap's announcement, if it has one\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KIND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"admin/tournaments/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Tournament item form sends.\"\"\"\n    kind: str = \"announcement\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    tournament_date: str = \"\"\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    announcement_id: int | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, item: TournamentItem) -> TournamentFields:\n        return cls(kind=item.kind, title_zh=item.title_zh, body_zh=item.body_zh,\n                   title_en=item.title_en, body_en=item.body_en,\n                   tournament_date=item.tournament_date, patch_id=item.patch_id,\n                   announcement_id=item.announcement_id)\n\n\n_TOURNAMENT_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT tournament_items.*, patches.name AS patch_name FROM tournament_items\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = tournament_items.patch_id\n\"\"\"\n# Newest first: the latest Tournament date, and the one added last on a day.\n_NEWEST_FIRST = \"ORDER BY tournament_date DESC, tournament_items.id DESC\"\n\n\ndef _item_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TournamentItem:\n    return TournamentItem(**{field.name: row[field.name]\n                             for field in fields_of(TournamentItem)})\n\n\ndef _checked_tournament_fields(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: TournamentFields,\n                               item_id: int | None = None) -> TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"The fields, with the date trimmed and an announcement's link dropped.\n    Raises Refused if the kind, date or Patch is missing, or a recap links\n    to anything but another announcement.\"\"\"\n    if fields.kind not in KIND_LABELS:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择预告或回顾。\")\n    day = fields.tournament_date.strip()\n    try:\n        valid = date.fromisoformat(day).isoformat() == day\n    except ValueError:\n        valid = False\n    if not valid:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写比赛日期，例如 2026-10-24。\")\n    if fields.patch_id is None or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM patches WHERE id = ?\", (fields.patch_id,)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    announcement_id = fields.announcement_id if fields.kind == \"recap\" else None\n    if announcement_id is not None and (announcement_id == item_id or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ? AND kind = 'announcement'\",\n            (announcement_id,)).fetchone()):\n        raise Refused(\"回顾只能关联一条锦标赛预告。\")\n    return replace(_trimmed(fields), tournament_date=day,\n                   announcement_id=announcement_id)\n\n\ndef _existing_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE tournament_items.id = ?\",\n                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这条锦标赛内容。\")\n    return _item_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Tournament item, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_item_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")]\n\n\ndef create_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                           fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO tournament_items (kind, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en,\"\n        \" tournament_date, patch_id, announcement_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id))\n    return _existing_item(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef save_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int,\n                         fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Change a Tournament item. AND kind = 'announcement'\",\n            (announcement_id,)).fetchone()):\n        raise Refused(\"回顾只能关联一条锦标赛预告。\")\n    return replace(_trimmed(fields), tournament_date=day,\n                   announcement_id=announcement_id)\n\n\ndef _existing_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE tournament_items.id = ?\",\n                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这条锦标赛内容。\")\n    return _item_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Tournament item, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_item_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")]\n\n\ndef create_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                           fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO tournament_items (kind, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en,\"\n        \" tournament_date, patch_id, announcement_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id))\n    return _existing_item(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef save_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int,\n                         fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Change a Tournament item. An\n    announcement made a recap is no longer one, so recaps stop linking to it.\"\"\"\n    current = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields, item_id)\n    published = current.status == \"published\"\n    if published:\n        _check_publishable(fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n                           fields.body_en)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE tournament_items SET kind = ?, title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?,\"\n        \" title_en = ?, body_en = ?, tournament_date = ?, patch_id = ?,\"\n        f\" announcement_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        + (f\", site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\" if published else \"\") + \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id, item_id))\n    if published:\n        _recaps_change_with(conn, current)\n    if fields.kind != \"announcement\":\n        _unlink_recaps_of(conn, current)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef _recaps_change_with(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: TournamentItem) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When an announcement is Published, Unpublished, edited while Published\n    or deleted, each Published recap linking to it changes on the site too:\n    its link appears, goes, or shows the new title.\"\"\"\n    if item.kind == \"announcement\":\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE tournament_items SET site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                     \" WHERE announcement_id = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n                     (item.id,))\n\n\ndef _unlink_recaps_of(conn: sqlite3.Connection, announcement: TournamentItem) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Recaps that linked to the announcement stop doing so.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE tournament_items SET announcement_id = NULL\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ?\", (announcement.id,))\n\n\ndef publish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                            item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _publish(conn, \"tournament_items\", item, \"锦标赛内容\")\n    _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef unpublish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                              item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _unpublish(conn, \"tournament_items\", item, \"锦标赛内容\")\n    _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef delete_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Tournament item for good; recaps that linked to it stay, with\n    no link.\"\"\"\n    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    if item.status == \"published\":\n        _recaps_change_with(conn, item)\n    _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item)\n    _record_removal(conn, \"tournament_item\", \"tournament_items\", item)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n\ndef published_tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Tournament item, newest first: all the Site build may\n    read.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE status = 'published' {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")\n    return [_item_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\"\"\"Tournament announcements (预告) and recaps (回顾) in the console, managed\nby Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to. Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import replace\nfrom typing import APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\nasync def tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    texts = {name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n             (\"kind\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\", \"tournament_date\")}\n    return TournamentFields(**texts,\n                            patch_id=id_or_none(form_text(form, \"patch_id\")),\n                            announcement_id=id_or_none(form_text(form, \"announcement_id\")))\n\n\nasync def sent_tournament_fields(request: request.form()\n    return await tournament_fields(request) if \"kind\" in form else None\n\n\ndef existing_item(item_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, item: TournamentItem | None,\n                fields: TournamentFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        if fields.patch_id is None and patches:  # a new item: the Current Patch\n            fields = replace(fields, patch_id=patches[0].id)\n        announcements = [other for other in content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n                         if other.kind == \"announcement\"\n                         and (item is None or other.id != item.id)]\n    title = (f\"编辑锦标赛{item.kind_label}：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if item\n             else \"新建锦标赛内容\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournament_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"item\": item, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"kinds\": content.KIND_LABELS, \"patches\": patches,\n         \"announcements\": announcements, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef tournament_list(request: Request, content.create_tournament_item(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, item, TournamentFields.of(item))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}\")\ndef save_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n              item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)],\n              fields: Annotated[TournamentFields, Depends(tournament_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            content.save_tournament_item(conn, user, item.id, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, item, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\" if item.status == \"draft\"\n          else \"已保存。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会看到改动。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                 item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)],\n                 fields: Annotated[TournamentFields | None,\n                                   Depends(sent_tournament_fields)]):\n    \"\"\"Publish, saving the editor's fields first when they came along; if\n    either is refused, neither is saved.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n def page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    return PageFields(**{name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n                         (\"slug\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\")})\n\n\nasync def sent_page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n Depends(page_manager)]) -> Page:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.page(conn, user, page_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, page: Page | None, fields: PageFields,\n                *, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    title = f\"编辑页面：{page.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if page else \"新建页面\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/page_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": \"tournament_date\": \"2026-10-24\", \"announcement_id\": \"\"}\n\n\ndef add_tournament_item(admin: TestClient, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Send the new Tournament item form: an announcement on the
