{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","hash":"199fa13ae855af6fb25a561a8d334c620aa934390edd68178032a1e9fd59025a","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_014ZbgzpQZhR78FJhexyS9V5","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]}}

{"parentUuid":"e83aef0d-6884-4d32-b03d-da123865d3a6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dab45f80-42a3-444d-8092-be343cf2ed99","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"ecc73994-ac22-4a8e-8f3d-a48906fd5fce","timestamp":"2026-10-18T04:24:23.051Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_014ZbgzpQZhR78FJhexyS9V5","session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"44a6d808-c2c9-4a70-b83c-503f7e0746d1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg94tNkbE5yfDCMfjvvT3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013FCD9Ttkt2HPa6aCUWmLLL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_s1_images.py","content":"\"\"\"S1: writers upload images into Guides and Tournament items, with alt text\nper language and a cover.\n\nSeam 1 is the console over HTTP and Seam 2 is `render_site`. Seam 3, agreed for\nthis ticket only, is the media folder on disk: tests list the file names there,\nto show that no file lands outside it and that deleted images are gone.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t03_guides import act, admin, editor, form_values, new_guide  # noqa: F401\n\n\ndef _png() -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real 1x1 PNG.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", 1, 1, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(b\"\\x00\\xff\\x00\\x00\"))\n            + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\nJPG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\\x01\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xd9\"\nWEBP = b\"RIFF\\x1a\\x00\\x00\\x00WEBPVP8L\\x0d\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x2f\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x10\\x07\\x10\\x11\\x11\\x88\\x88\\xfe\\x07\\x00\"\nGIF = b\"GIF89a\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x80\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xff\\xff!\\xf9\\x04\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00,\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x02\\x02D\\x01\\x00;\"\nSVG = b'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>'\n\nSNIPPET = re.compile(r\"<code>!\\[\\]\\(([0-9a-f]{32}\\.(?:png|jpg|webp|gif))\\)</code>\")\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes, name: str = \"lineup.png\",\n           values: dict[str, str] | None = None, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Choose a file in the editor's image section and press 上传. The rest\n    of the editor form (`values`, or what the page shows) comes along.\"\"\"\n    page = c.get(edit_page).text\n    sent = (form_values(page) if values is None else values) | fields\n    return c.post(f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images\",\n                  data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(page), **sent},\n                  files={\"image\": (name, data, \"application/octet-stream\")},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef images_on(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The stored file names of the images an editor page lists, in order.\"\"\"\n    return SNIPPET.findall(page)\n\n\ndef uploaded(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes = PNG, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Upload an image; returns its stored file name.\"\"\"\n    before = images_on(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    response = upload(c, edit_page, data, **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    [new] = [name for name in images_on(c.get(edit_page).text) if name not in before]\n    return new\n\n\ndef image_url(edit_page: str, filename: str) -> str:\n    return f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images/{filename}\"\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_uploads_a_screenshot_to_their_own_draft(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    response = upload(editor, edit_page, PNG)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n    assert \"图片已上传\" in page\n    [filename] = images_on(page)\n\n    image = editor.get(image_url(edit_page, filename))\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == PNG\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"image/png\"\n    assert image.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":818,"cache_read_input_tokens":179061,"output_tokens":2607,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":754},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":818,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2607,"cache_read_input_tokens":179061,"cache_creation_input_tokens":818,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":818},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_013FCD9Ttkt2HPa6aCUWmLLL":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_s1_images.py","content":"\"\"\"S1: writers upload images into Guides and Tournament items, with alt text\nper language and a cover.\n\nSeam 1 is the console over HTTP and Seam 2 is `render_site`. Seam 3, agreed for\nthis ticket only, is the media folder on disk: tests list the file names there,\nto show that no file lands outside it and that deleted images are gone.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t03_guides import act, admin, editor, form_values, new_guide  # noqa: F401\n\n\ndef _png() -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real 1x1 PNG.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", 1, 1, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(b\"\\x00\\xff\\x00\\x00\"))\n            + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\nJPG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\\x01\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xd9\"\nWEBP = b\"RIFF\\x1a\\x00\\x00\\x00WEBPVP8L\\x0d\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x2f\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x10\\x07\\x10\\x11\\x11\\x88\\x88\\xfe\\x07\\x00\"\nGIF = b\"GIF89a\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x80\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xff\\xff!\\xf9\\x04\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00,\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x02\\x02D\\x01\\x00;\"\nSVG = b'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>'\n\nSNIPPET = re.compile(r\"<code>!\\[\\]\\(([0-9a-f]{32}\\.(?:png|jpg|webp|gif))\\)</code>\")\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes, name: str = \"lineup.png\",\n           values: dict[str, str] | None = None, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Choose a file in the editor's image section and press 上传. The rest\n    of the editor form (`values`, or what the page shows) comes along.\"\"\"\n    page = c.get(edit_page).text\n    sent = (form_values(page) if values is None else values) | fields\n    return c.post(f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images\",\n                  data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(page), **sent},\n                  files={\"image\": (name, data, \"application/octet-stream\")},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef images_on(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The stored file names of the images an editor page lists, in order.\"\"\"\n    return SNIPPET.findall(page)\n\n\ndef uploaded(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes = PNG, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Upload an image; returns its stored file name.\"\"\"\n    before = images_on(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    response = upload(c, edit_page, data, **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    [new] = [name for name in images_on(c.get(edit_page).text) if name not in before]\n    return new\n\n\ndef image_url(edit_page: str, filename: str) -> str:\n    return f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images/{filename}\"\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_uploads_a_screenshot_to_their_own_draft(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    response = upload(editor, edit_page, PNG)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n    assert \"图片已上传\" in page\n    [filename] = images_on(page)\n\n    image = editor.get(image_url(edit_page, filename))\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == PNG\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"image/png\"\n    assert image.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n"}},"apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011Cg94tNQmArGfiVCrfrgF8","requestRef":"c6390262-c735-4076-9a65-4f10421365e4","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"1d9ebf36-6690-41ee-a36d-0f33e6649021","timestamp":"2026-10-18T04:25:56.715Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Slice 1 (tracer bullet): an Editor uploads a PNG to their own Draft, sees it listed with its snippet, and the console serves it back."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013FCD9Ttkt2HPa6aCUWmLLL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_s1_images.py","content":"\"\"\"S1: writers upload images into Guides and Tournament items, with alt text\nper language and a cover.\n\nSeam 1 is the console over HTTP and Seam 2 is `render_site`. Seam 3, agreed for\nthis ticket only, is the media folder on disk: tests list the file names there,\nto show that no file lands outside it and that deleted images are gone.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\nfrom test_t03_guides import act, admin, editor, form_values, new_guide  # noqa: F401\n\n\ndef _png() -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real 1x1 PNG.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", 1, 1, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(b\"\\x00\\xff\\x00\\x00\"))\n            + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\nJPG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\\x01\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xd9\"\nWEBP = b\"RIFF\\x1a\\x00\\x00\\x00WEBPVP8L\\x0d\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x2f\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x10\\x07\\x10\\x11\\x11\\x88\\x88\\xfe\\x07\\x00\"\nGIF = b\"GIF89a\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x80\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\xff\\xff\\xff!\\xf9\\x04\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00,\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x02\\x02D\\x01\\x00;\"\nSVG = b'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>'\n\nSNIPPET = re.compile(r\"<code>!\\[\\]\\(([0-9a-f]{32}\\.(?:png|jpg|webp|gif))\\)</code>\")\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes, name: str = \"lineup.png\",\n           values: dict[str, str] | None = None, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Choose a file in the editor's image section and press 上传. The rest\n    of the editor form (`values`, or what the page shows) comes along.\"\"\"\n    page = c.get(edit_page).text\n    sent = (form_values(page) if values is None else values) | fields\n    return c.post(f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images\",\n                  data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(page), **sent},\n                  files={\"image\": (name, data, \"application/octet-stream\")},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef images_on(page: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The stored file names of the images an editor page lists, in order.\"\"\"\n    return SNIPPET.findall(page)\n\n\ndef uploaded(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, data: bytes = PNG, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Upload an image; returns its stored file name.\"\"\"\n    before = images_on(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    response = upload(c, edit_page, data, **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    [new] = [name for name in images_on(c.get(edit_page).text) if name not in before]\n    return new\n\n\ndef image_url(edit_page: str, filename: str) -> str:\n    return f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images/{filename}\"\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_uploads_a_screenshot_to_their_own_draft(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    response = upload(editor, edit_page, PNG)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n    assert \"图片已上传\" in page\n    [filename] = images_on(page)\n\n    image = editor.get(image_url(edit_page, filename))\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == PNG\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"image/png\"\n    assert image.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FMZWbbbp5V8we3GjV4kBFu","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && uv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | tail -5","description":"Run new test file (expect red)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"62c423d5-18a0-4e84-a85b-1d20749afe4b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg94vAP1hWgNvzsgDYiWt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KGjzvP3BTDkiQV4tQGL2q8","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"app/settings.py\")\ns = p.read_text()\ns = s.replace('''def database_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n''', '''def database_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n\n\ndef media_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"The folder of uploaded images (never committed). {"parentUuid":"3a39fc48-113f-46d9-8422-2c6f053fbca0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg94vz1hRyj5UZY4LPSbu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GZMwvf67bUMR9TnRg1fPME","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/media.py","content":"\"\"\"Uploaded images: checking them, storing them, and the rows that say whose\nthey are.\n\nAn image belongs to one owner, a Guide, a Guide's open Revision or a\nTournament item, named by a key such as \"guide/12\" (see `owner_of`). It can be\nused in both languages' text, as `![](<filename>)`, and has optional alt text\nper language. The owner's cover is one of its images, by file name, kept on\nthe owner's own row: NULL means the first image, and '' means none.\n\nOnly PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF are accepted, recognised by their content (an SVG\ncan carry script, so it never is). The stored file name is generated here;\nthe uploaded name is only checked for its extension and never touches the\ndisk. Files live in the media folder (settings.media_path()). A Revision's\nimages are copies of its Guide's rows that share their files, so a file is\ndeleted only once no row names it.\n\nWho may change an owner's images is decided by app/guides.py and\napp/content.py, which call these functions once they have checked.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nMAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024\nALLOWED = \"PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF\"\nEXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".webp\", \".gif\"}\nCONTENT_TYPES = {\".png\": \"image/png\", \".jpg\": \"image/jpeg\", \".webp\": \"image/webp\",\n                 \".gif\": \"image/gif\"}\nFILENAME = re.compile(r\"[0-9a-f]{32}\\.(png|jpg|webp|gif)\")\n\n\nclass BadImage(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An upload that is refused, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Upload:\n    \"\"\"A file as the browser sent it. `data` holds at most MAX_BYTES + 1\n    bytes, enough to tell that a file is too large.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    data: bytes\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Image:\n    id: int\n    filename: str\n    alt_zh: str\n    alt_en: str\n\n    def alt(self, lang: str) -> str:\n        return getattr(self, f\"alt_{lang}\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageFields:\n    \"\"\"What an editor form sends about its images: alt text by image id, as\n    (Chinese, English), for the images it showed, and the chosen cover's file\n    name. cover is None when the form sent no choice.\"\"\"\n    alts: Mapping[int, tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    cover: str | None = None\n\n\ndef _kind_by_content(data: bytes) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The extension that `data` really is, by its first bytes.\"\"\"\n    if data.startswith(b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"):\n        return \".png\"\n    if data.startswith(b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\"):\n        return \".jpg\"\n    if data[:4] == b\"RIFF\" and data[8:12] == b\"WEBP\":\n        return \".webp\"\n    if data[:6] in (b\"GIF87a\", b\"GIF89a\"):\n        return \".gif\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef checked(upload: Upload) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The extension to store `upload` under, or BadImage saying why not.\"\"\"\n    if not upload.name and not upload.data:\n        raise BadImage(\"请先选择要上传的图片。\")\n    extension = Path(upload.name.lower()).suffix\n    if extension not in EXTENSIONS:\n        raise BadImage(f\"只能上传 {ALLOWED} 图片（不支持 SVG），\"\n                       f\"“{upload.name}”不是。\")\n    if len(upload.data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise BadImage(f\"图片不能超过 5 MB，“{upload.name}”太大了。\")\n    kind = _kind_by_content(upload.data)\n    if kind is None:\n        raise BadImage(f\"“{upload.name}”的内容不是 {ALLOWED} 图片，\"\n                       \"可能只是改了扩展名。\")\n    return kind\n\n\ndef images(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str) -> list[Image]:\n    \"\"\"The owner's images, in the order they were uploaded.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT id, filename, alt_zh, alt_en FROM images\"\n                        \" WHERE owner = ? ORDER BY id\", (owner,)).fetchall()\n    return [Image(**dict(row)) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, upload: Upload) -> Image:\n    \"\"\"Check `upload` and store it as the owner's newest image.\"\"\"\n    filename = secrets.token_hex(16) + checked(upload)\n    folder = settings.media_path()\n    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    (folder / filename).write_bytes(upload.data)\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO images (owner, filename) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                       (owner, filename))\n    return Image(cur.lastrowid or 0, filename, \"\", \"\")\n\n\ndef image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, image_id: int) -> Image | None:\n    return next((found for found in images(conn, owner) if found.id == image_id), None)\n\n\ndef file(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"The file of the owner's image called `filename`, if it has one.\"\"\"\n    if not FILENAME.fullmatch(filename) or not any(\n            found.filename == filename for found in images(conn, owner)):\n        return None\n    path = settings.media_path() / filename\n    return path if path.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef content_type(filename: str) -> str:\n    return CONTENT_TYPES[Path(filename).suffix]\n\n\ndef save_alts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, fields: ImageFields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Keep the alt text the form sent for the owner's images.\"\"\"\n    conn.executemany(\"UPDATE images SET alt_zh = ?, alt_en = ? WHERE id = ? AND owner = ?\",\n                     [(zh.strip(), en.strip(), image_id, owner)\n                      for image_id, (zh, en) in fields.alts.items()])\n\n\ndef checked_cover(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, cover: str | None, *,\n                  optional: bool) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover to keep from what a form sent: None (the first image) unless\n    it names one of the owner's images, or is '' and the owner may have no\n    cover at all.\"\"\"\n    if cover == \"\" and optional:\n        return \"\"\n    return cover if any(found.filename == cover for found in images(conn, owner)) else None\n\n\ndef cover(found: list[Image], chosen: str | None) -> Image | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover among `found` (an owner's images): the chosen one, else the\n    first, or none if the owner chose none or has no images.\"\"\"\n    if chosen == \"\":\n        return None\n    return next((image for image in found if image.filename == chosen),\n                found[0] if found else None)\n\n\ndef _delete_unused_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filenames: Iterable[str]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete the files no image row names any more. This happens before the\n    transaction commits; if the commit then failed, the image would only show\n    as missing.\"\"\"\n    for filename in set(filenames):\n        if not conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM images WHERE filename = ?\",\n                            (filename,)).fetchone():\n            (settings.media_path() / filename).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\ndef remove(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, image_id: int) -> None:\n    found = image(conn, owner, image_id)\n    if found is None:\n        return\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE id = ?\", (image_id,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, [found.filename])\n\n\ndef remove_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str) -> None:\n    filenames = [found.filename for found in images(conn, owner)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (owner,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, filenames)\n\n\ndef copy_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Give `target` its own copy of each of `source`'s images (rows only;\n    the two share the files).\"\"\"\n    remove_all(conn, target)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO images (owner, filename, alt_zh, alt_en)\"\n                 \" SELECT ?, filename, alt_zh, alt_en FROM images WHERE owner = ?\"\n                 \" ORDER BY id\", (target, source))\n\n\ndef move_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `target`'s images with `source`'s, which `source` loses.\"\"\"\n    old = [found.filename for found in images(conn, target)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (target,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE images SET owner = ? WHERE owner = ?\", (target, source))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, old)\n\n\ndef used_in(text: str, filename: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether Markdown `text` refers to the image called `filename`.\"\"\"\n    return filename in text\n\n\ndef sources(found: list[Image], lang: str, src: str) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"What render_markdown needs to show `found` (an owner's images) on one\n    page in `lang`: each file name, as written in the text, mapped to the\n    `src` to use there (`src` with \"{}\" in place of the file name) and its alt\n    text in `lang`.\"\"\"\n    return {image.filename: (src.format(image.filename), image.alt(lang))\n            for image in found}\n\n\ndef copy_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owners: Iterable[str], out: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Copy the owners' image files into the folder `out`.\"\"\"\n    for owner in owners:\n        for found in images(conn, owner):\n            source = settings.media_path() / found.filename\n            if source.is_file():\n                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                shutil.copyfile(source, out / found.filename)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1325,"cache_read_input_tokens":182760,"output_tokens":3764,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":94},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1325,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3764,"cache_read_input_tokens":182760,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1325,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1325},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01GZMwvf67bUMR9TnRg1fPME":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/media.py","content":"\"\"\"Uploaded WHERE id = ? AND owner = ?\",\n                     [(zh.strip(), en.strip(), image_id, owner)\n                      for image_id, (zh, en) in fields.alts.items()])\n\n\ndef checked_cover(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, cover: str | None, *,\n                  optional: bool) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover to keep from what a form sent: None (the first image) unless\n    it names one of the owner's images, or is '' and the owner may have no\n    cover at all.\"\"\"\n    if cover == \"\" and optional:\n        return \"\"\n    return cover if any(found.filename == cover for found in images(conn, owner)) else None\n\n\ndef cover(found: list[Image], chosen: str | None) -> Image | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover among `found` (an owner's images): the chosen one, else the\n    first, or none if the owner chose none or has no images.\"\"\"\n    if chosen == \"\":\n        return None\n    return next((image for image in found if image.filename == chosen),\n                found[0] if found else None)\n\n\ndef _delete_unused_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filenames: Iterable[str]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete the files no image row names any more. This happens before the\n    transaction commits; if the commit then failed, the image would only show\n    as missing.\"\"\"\n    for filename in set(filenames):\n        if not conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM images WHERE filename = ?\",\n                            (filename,)).fetchone():\n            (settings.media_path() / filename).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\ndef remove(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, image_id: int) -> None:\n    found = image(conn, owner, image_id)\n    if found is None:\n        return\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE id = ?\", (image_id,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, [found.filename])\n\n\ndef remove_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str) -> None:\n    filenames = [found.filename for found in images(conn, owner)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (owner,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, filenames)\n\n\ndef copy_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Give `target` its own copy of each of `source`'s images (rows only;\n    the two share the files).\"\"\"\n    remove_all(conn, target)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO images (owner, filename, alt_zh, alt_en)\"\n                 \" SELECT ?, filename, alt_zh, alt_en FROM images WHERE owner = ?\"\n                 \" ORDER BY id\", (target, source))\n\n\ndef move_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `target`'s images with `source`'s, which `source` loses.\"\"\"\n    old = [found.filename for found in images(conn, target)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (target,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE images SET owner = ? WHERE owner = ?\", (target, source))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, old)\n\n\ndef used_in(text: str, filename: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether Markdown `text` refers to the image called `filename`.\"\"\"\n    return filename in text\n\n\ndef sources(found: list[Image], lang: str, src: str) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"What render_markdown needs to show `found` (an owner's images) on one\n    page in `lang`: each file name, as written in the text, mapped to the\n    `src` to use there (`src` with \"{}\" in place of the file name) and its alt\n    text in `lang`.\"\"\"\n    return {image.filename: (src.format(image.filename), image.alt(lang))\n            for image in found}\n\n\ndef copy_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owners: Iterable[str], out: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Copy the owners' image files into the folder `out`.\"\"\"\n    for owner in owners:\n        for found in images(conn, owner):\n            source = settings.media_path() / found.filename\n            if source.is_file():\n                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                shutil.copyfile(source, out / found.filename)\n"}},"apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011Cg94vyh6WgaVWa2ayZ4SF","requestRef":"577d4ac2-5548-45e2-81b3-3f46ba6e325e","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"01ba627a-06b3-4c26-869b-fa01b88ba136","timestamp":"2026-10-18T04:26:41.450Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"01ba627a-06b3-4c26-869b-fa01b88ba136","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dab45f80-42a3-444d-8092-be343cf2ed99","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GZMwvf67bUMR9TnRg1fPME","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/media.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"43569ef2-7a65-480d-aa03-88eada21fa94","timestamp":"2026-10-18T04:26:41.641Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/media.py","content":"\"\"\"Uploaded images: checking them, storing them, and the rows that say whose\nthey are.\n\nAn image belongs to one owner, a Guide, a Guide's open Revision or a\nTournament item, named by a key such as \"guide/12\" (see `owner_of`). It can be\nused in both languages' text, as `![](<filename>)`, and has optional alt text\nper language. The owner's cover is one of its images, by file name, kept on\nthe owner's own row: NULL means the first image, and '' means none.\n\nOnly PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF are accepted, recognised by their content (an SVG\ncan carry script, so it never is). The stored file name is generated here;\nthe uploaded name is only checked for its extension and never touches the\ndisk. Files live in the media folder (settings.media_path()). A Revision's\nimages are copies of its Guide's rows that share their files, so a file is\ndeleted only once no row names it.\n\nWho may change an owner's images is decided by app/guides.py and\napp/content.py, which call these functions once they have checked.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nMAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024\nALLOWED = \"PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF\"\nEXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".webp\", \".gif\"}\nCONTENT_TYPES = {\".png\": \"image/png\", \".jpg\": \"image/jpeg\", \".webp\": \"image/webp\",\n                 \".gif\": \"image/gif\"}\nFILENAME = re.compile(r\"[0-9a-f]{32}\\.(png|jpg|webp|gif)\")\n\n\nclass BadImage(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An upload that is refused, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Upload:\n    \"\"\"A file as the browser sent it. `data` holds at most MAX_BYTES + 1\n    bytes, enough to tell that a file is too large.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    data: bytes\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Image:\n    id: int\n    filename: str\n    alt_zh: str\n    alt_en: str\n\n    def alt(self, lang: str) -> str:\n        return getattr(self, f\"alt_{lang}\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageFields:\n    \"\"\"What an editor form sends about its images: alt text by image id, as\n    (Chinese, English), for the images it showed, and the chosen cover's file\n    name. cover is None when the form sent no choice.\"\"\"\n    alts: Mapping[int, tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    cover: str | None = None\n\n\ndef _kind_by_content(data: bytes) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The extension that `data` really is, by its first bytes.\"\"\"\n    if data.startswith(b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"):\n        return \".png\"\n    if data.startswith(b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\"):\n        return \".jpg\"\n    if data[:4] == b\"RIFF\" and data[8:12] == b\"WEBP\":\n        return \".webp\"\n    if data[:6] in (b\"GIF87a\", b\"GIF89a\"):\n        return \".gif\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef checked(upload: Upload) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The extension to store `upload` under, or BadImage saying why not.\"\"\"\n    if not upload.name and not upload.data:\n        raise BadImage(\"请先选择要上传的图片。\")\n    extension = Path(upload.name.lower()).suffix\n    if extension not in EXTENSIONS:\n        raise BadImage(f\"只能上传 {ALLOWED} 图片（不支持 SVG），\"\n                       f\"“{upload.name}”不是。\")\n    if len(upload.data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise BadImage(f\"图片不能超过 5 MB，“{upload.name}”太大了。\")\n    kind = _kind_by_content(upload.data)\n    if kind is None:\n        raise BadImage(f\"“{upload.name}”的内容不是 {ALLOWED} 图片，\"\n                       \"可能只是改了扩展名。\")\n    return kind\n\n\ndef images(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str) -> list[Image]:\n    \"\"\"The owner's images, in the order they were uploaded.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT id, filename, alt_zh, alt_en FROM images\"\n                        \" WHERE owner = ? ORDER BY id\", (owner,)).fetchall()\n    return [Image(**dict(row)) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, upload: Upload) -> Image:\n    \"\"\"Check `upload` and store it as the owner's newest image.\"\"\"\n    filename = secrets.token_hex(16) + checked(upload)\n    folder = settings.media_path()\n    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    (folder / filename).write_bytes(upload.data)\n    cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO images (owner, filename) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                       (owner, filename))\n    return Image(cur.lastrowid or 0, filename, \"\", \"\")\n\n\ndef image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, image_id: int) -> Image | None:\n    return next((found for found in images(conn, owner) if found.id == image_id), None)\n\n\ndef file(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"The file of the owner's image called `filename`, if it has one.\"\"\"\n    if not FILENAME.fullmatch(filename) or not any(\n            found.filename == filename for found in images(conn, owner)):\n        return None\n    path = settings.media_path() / filename\n    return path if path.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef content_type(filename: str) -> str:\n    return CONTENT_TYPES[Path(filename).suffix]\n\n\ndef save_alts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, fields: ImageFields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Keep the alt text the form sent for the owner's images.\"\"\"\n    conn.executemany(\"UPDATE images SET alt_zh = ?, alt_en = ? WHERE id = ? AND owner = ?\",\n                     [(zh.strip(), en.strip(), image_id, owner)\n                      for image_id, (zh, en) in fields.alts.items()])\n\n\ndef checked_cover(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, cover: str | None, *,\n                  optional: bool) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover to keep from what a form sent: None (the first image) unless\n    it names one of the owner's images, or is '' and the owner may have no\n    cover at all.\"\"\"\n    if cover == \"\" and optional:\n        return \"\"\n    return cover if any(found.filename == cover for found in images(conn, owner)) else None\n\n\ndef cover(found: list[Image], chosen: str | None) -> Image | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover among `found` (an owner's images): the chosen one, else the\n    first, or none if the owner chose none or has no images.\"\"\"\n    if chosen == \"\":\n        return None\n    return next((image for image in found if image.filename == chosen),\n                found[0] if found else None)\n\n\ndef _delete_unused_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filenames: Iterable[str]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete the files no image row names any more. This happens before the\n    transaction commits; if the commit then failed, the image would only show\n    as missing.\"\"\"\n    for filename in set(filenames):\n        if not conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM images WHERE filename = ?\",\n                            (filename,)).fetchone():\n            (settings.media_path() / filename).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\ndef remove(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str, image_id: int) -> None:\n    found = image(conn, owner, image_id)\n    if found is None:\n        return\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE id = ?\", (image_id,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, [found.filename])\n\n\ndef remove_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owner: str) -> None:\n    filenames = [found.filename for found in images(conn, owner)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (owner,))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, filenames)\n\n\ndef copy_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Give `target` its own copy of each of `source`'s images (rows only;\n    the two share the files).\"\"\"\n    remove_all(conn, target)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO images (owner, filename, alt_zh, alt_en)\"\n                 \" SELECT ?, filename, alt_zh, alt_en FROM images WHERE owner = ?\"\n                 \" ORDER BY id\", (target, source))\n\n\ndef move_all(conn: sqlite3.Connection, source: str, target: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `target`'s images with `source`'s, which `source` loses.\"\"\"\n    old = [found.filename for found in images(conn, target)]\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM images WHERE owner = ?\", (target,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE images SET owner = ? WHERE owner = ?\", (target, source))\n    _delete_unused_files(conn, old)\n\n\ndef used_in(text: str, filename: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether Markdown `text` refers to the image called `filename`.\"\"\"\n    return filename in text\n\n\ndef sources(found: list[Image], lang: str, src: str) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"What render_markdown needs to show `found` (an owner's images) on one\n    page in `lang`: each file name, as written in the text, mapped to the\n    `src` to use there (`src` with \"{}\" in place of the file name) and its alt\n    text in `lang`.\"\"\"\n    return {image.filename: (src.format(image.filename), image.alt(lang))\n            for image in found}\n\n\ndef copy_files(conn: sqlite3.Connection, owners: Iterable[str], out: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Copy the owners' image files into the folder `out`.\"\"\"\n    for owner in owners:\n        for found in images(conn, owner):\n            source = settings.media_path() / found.filename\n            if source.is_file():\n                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                shutil.copyfile(source, out / found.filename)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"01ba627a-06b3-4c26-869b-fa01b88ba136","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"app/guides.py\")\ns = p.read_text()\ndef rep(old, new, count=1):\n    global s\n    assert s.count(old) == count, (old, s.count(old))\n    s = s.replace(old, new)\n\n# save(): alt text and cover with the rest of the form\nrep('''    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n''', '''    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        _check_text(fields)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        f\" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, cover = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug,\n         _kept_cover(conn, current, fields), guide_id))\n    media.save_alts(conn, current.media_owner, fields.images)\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef _kept_cover(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: Guide | Revision,\n                fields: GuideFields) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The cover to keep: the one the form chose, if it sent a choice.\"\"\"\n    if fields.images.cover is None:\n        return item.cover\n    return media.checked_cover(conn, item.media_owner, fields.images.cover,\n                               optional=False)\n\n\ndef _changeable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, if `actor` may save it.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if not can_edit(actor, current):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改。\")\n    return current\n\n\ndef _add_image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: Guide | Revision,\n               upload: media.Upload) -> media.Image:\n    try:\n        added = media.add(conn, item.media_owner, upload)\n    except media.BadImage as bad:\n        raise Refused(bad.message) from None\n    _touch(conn, item)\n    return added\n\n\ndef _remove_image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: Guide | Revision,\n                  image_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete one of the item's images, unless its text still uses it.\"\"\"\n    found = media.image(conn, item.media_owner, image_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound(\"找不到这张图片，它可能已经被删除了。\")\n    for where, body in [(\"中文正文\", item.body_zh), (\"英文正文\", item.body_en)]:\n        if media.used_in(body, found.filename):\n            raise Refused(f\"{where}还在使用这张图片。请先从{where}里删掉\"\n                          f\" ![]({found.filename})，再删除图片。\")\n    media.remove(conn, item.media_owner, image_id)\n    _touch(conn, item)\n\n\ndef _touch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item: Guide | Revision) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Mark the Guide (or Revision) as changed now, as a save does.\"\"\"\n    table, key = (\"revisions\", \"guide_id\") if item.is_revision else (\"guides\", \"id\")\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE {key} = ?\", (item.id,))\n\n\ndef images(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> list[media.Image]:\n    \"\"\"The Guide's images, for anyone who may see it.\"\"\"\n    return media.images(conn, _editable(conn, actor, guide_id).media_owner)\n\n\ndef add_image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n              upload: media.Upload) -> media.Image:\n    \"\"\"Upload an image into a Guide `actor` may save.\"\"\"\n    return _add_image(conn, _changeable(conn, actor, guide_id), upload)\n\n\ndef remove_image(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n                 image_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete an image of a Guide `actor` may save, unless its text uses it.\"\"\"\n    _remove_image(conn, _changeable(conn, actor, guide_id), image_id)\n\n\ndef image_file(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n               filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"The file of the Guide's image called `filename`, for anyone who may\n    see the Guide; None if it has no such image.\"\"\"\n    return media.file(conn, _editable(conn, actor, guide_id).media_owner, filename)\n''')\nrep('''import re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses''', '''import re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom dataclasses''')\np.write_text(s)\nEOF","description":"Add Guide image functions to the workflow"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"de87bec3-8ee3-402e-9c6d-ff7241640928","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg955gFcHM4o8PMMpked4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018ko8BfN19mzZKeFcLTvuiu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/templates/admin/_images.html","content":"{# The image section of an editor form (a Guide's, a Revision's or a\n   Tournament item's). It sits inside that form, so each of its buttons saves\n   the rest of the form too. `path` is the owner's console path, `images` its\n   images, `cover` its cover now, and `no_cover` whether it may have none. #}\n    <fieldset class=\"images\">\n      <legend>图片</legend>\n      {% if not saved %}\n      <p>保存草稿后就可以上传图片。</p>\n      {% else %}\n      <p>每张图片都可以同时用在中文版和英文版里：把它的代码放进正文就行。说明（alt）会在图片显示不出来、或读者用读屏软件时代替图片，按语言分别填写。</p>\n      {% for image in images %}\n      {% set alt_zh, alt_en = fields.images.alts.get(image.id, (image.alt_zh, image.alt_en)) %}\n      <div class=\"image\">\n        <img src=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images/{{ image.filename }}\" alt=\"{{ alt_zh }}\">\n        <div>\n          <p><code>![]({{ image.filename }})</code>\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"insert\" data-target=\"body_zh\" data-snippet=\"![]({{ image.filename }})\" hidden>插入中文正文</button>\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"insert\" data-target=\"body_en\" data-snippet=\"![]({{ image.filename }})\" hidden>插入英文正文</button></p>\n          <label>中文说明（可选）\n            <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_zh_{{ image.id }}\" value=\"{{ alt_zh }}\">\n          </label>\n          <label>英文说明（可选）\n            <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_en_{{ image.id }}\" value=\"{{ alt_en }}\">\n          </label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cover\" value=\"{{ image.filename }}\"{% if cover and cover.id == image.id %} checked{% endif %}> 用作封面</label>\n          <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images/{{ image.id }}/delete\">删除这张图片</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      {% endfor %}\n      {% if images and no_cover %}\n      <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cover\" value=\"\"{% if not cover %} checked{% endif %}> 不用封面</label>\n      {% endif %}\n      {% if images %}<p>封面会显示在网站的列表里{% if not no_cover %}，没选的话用第一张{% endif %}。</p>{% endif %}\n      <label>上传图片（{{ allowed_images }}，每张最大 5 MB）\n        <input type=\"file\" name=\"image\" accept=\"image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif\">\n      </label>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images\" formenctype=\"multipart/form-data\">上传</button>\n      <script>\n        // Without this script, the writer copies an image's code by hand.\n        document.querySelectorAll(\"button.insert\").forEach((button) => {\n          button.hidden = false;\n          button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0a12d330-56e0-42d6-ba9c-95ac300ed884","hash":"bfe4d1e150ea8724c36d05d33c0af8923a7adc347e12bc5bc720f5b364aeafce","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"Now the image section template and its place in the Guide editor."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018ko8BfN19mzZKeFcLTvuiu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/templates/admin/_images.html","content":"{# The image section of an editor form (a Guide's, a Revision's or a\n   Tournament item's). It sits inside that form, so each of its buttons saves\n   the rest of the form too. `path` is the owner's console path, `images` its\n   images, `cover` its cover now, and `no_cover` whether it may have none. #}\n    <fieldset class=\"images\">\n      <legend>图片</legend>\n      {% if not saved %}\n      <p>保存草稿后就可以上传图片。</p>\n      {% else %}\n      <p>每张图片都可以同时用在中文版和英文版里：把它的代码放进正文就行。说明（alt）会在图片显示不出来、或读者用读屏软件时代替图片，按语言分别填写。</p>\n      {% for image in images %}\n      {% set alt_zh, alt_en = fields.images.alts.get(image.id, (image.alt_zh, image.alt_en)) %}\n      <div class=\"image\">\n        <img src=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images/{{ image.filename }}\" alt=\"{{ alt_zh }}\">\n        <div>\n          <p><code>![]({{ image.filename }})</code>\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"insert\" data-target=\"body_zh\" data-snippet=\"![]({{ image.filename }})\" hidden>插入中文正文</button>\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"insert\" data-target=\"body_en\" data-snippet=\"![]({{ image.filename }})\" hidden>插入英文正文</button></p>\n          <label>中文说明（可选）\n            <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_zh_{{ image.id }}\" value=\"{{ alt_zh }}\">\n          </label>\n          <label>英文说明（可选）\n            <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_en_{{ image.id }}\" value=\"{{ alt_en }}\">\n          </label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cover\" value=\"{{ image.filename }}\"{% if cover and cover.id == image.id %} checked{% endif %}> 用作封面</label>\n          <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images/{{ image.id }}/delete\">删除这张图片</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      {% endfor %}\n      {% if images and no_cover %}\n      <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cover\" value=\"\"{% if not cover %} checked{% endif %}> 不用封面</label>\n      {% endif %}\n      {% if images %}<p>封面会显示在网站的列表里{% if not no_cover %}，没选的话用第一张{% endif %}。</p>{% endif %}\n      <label>上传图片（{{ allowed_images }}，每张最大 5 MB）\n        <input type=\"file\" name=\"image\" accept=\"image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif\">\n      </label>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/images\" formenctype=\"multipart/form-data\">上传</button>\n      <script>\n        // Without this script, the writer copies an image's code by hand.\n        document.querySelectorAll(\"button.insert\").forEach((button) => {\n          button.hidden = false;\n          button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n            const body = button.form.elements[button.dataset.target];\n            body.setRangeText(button.dataset.snippet, body.selectionStart,\n                              body.selectionEnd, \"end\");\n            body.focus();\n          });\n        });\n      </script>\n      {% endif %}\n    </fieldset>\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AxeDpEoYPgCPxDrgxUrCJ2","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd Slice 2 covers which files are accepted and which are refused."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VKbM52pnLdoS5RGDaJFiSm","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && cat >> tests/test_s1_images.py <<'EOF'\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name, data, content_type\", [\n    (\"deck.jpg\", JPG, \"image/jpeg\"), (\"deck.JPEG\", JPG, \"image/jpeg\"),\n    (\"deck.webp\", WEBP, \"image/webp\"), (\"deck.gif\", GIF, \"image/gif\"),\n])\ndef test_jpg_webp_and_gif_screenshots_are_accepted_too(editor, name, data, content_type):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    assert upload(editor, edit_page, data, name=name).status_code == 303\n    [filename] = images_on(editor.get(edit_page).text)\n    image = editor.get(image_url(edit_page, filename))\n    assert image.content == data\n    assert image.headers[\"content-type\"] == content_type\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name, data, message\", [\n    (\"deck.svg\", SVG, \"不支持 SVG\"),\n    (\"deck.png\", SVG, \"内容不是 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片\"),\n    (\"notes.png\", b\"%PDF-1.7 not an image\", \"内容不是 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片\"),\n    (\"notes.txt\", PNG, \"只能上传 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片\"),\n    (\"huge.png\", PNG + b\"\\0\" * (5 * 1024 * 1024), \"图片不能超过 5 MB\"),\n    (\"\", b\"\", \"请先选择要上传的图片\"),\n])\ndef test_anything_but_a_png_jpg_webp_or_gif_of_at_most_5_mb_is_refused_with_a_message(\n        editor, name, data, message):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    response = upload(editor, edit_page, data, name=name)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    assert images_on(editor.get(edit_page).text) == []\n\n\ndef test_an_image_of_exactly_5_mb_is_accepted(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    data = PNG + b\"\\0\" * (5 * 1024 * 1024 - len(PNG))\n    assert upload(editor, edit_page, data).status_code == 303\n    assert len(images_on(editor.get(edit_page).text)) == 1\n\n\ndef files_in(folder: Path) -> set[str]:\n    return {path.name for path in folder.iterdir()} if folder.exists() else set()\n\n\ndef test_the_server_names_each_stored_file_so_an_uploaded_name_cannot_escape(\n        editor, tmp_path):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    before = files_in(tmp_path)\n    for name in [\"../../x.png\", \"..\\\\..\\\\x.png\", \"/tmp/x.png\", \"lineup.png\"]:\n        assert upload(editor, edit_page, PNG, name=name).status_code == 303\n    stored = images_on(editor.get(edit_page).text)\n    assert len(set(stored)) == 4\n    assert files_in(tmp_path / \"media\") == set(stored)\n    assert files_in(tmp_path) - before == {\"media\"}\n    assert not (tmp_path.parent / \"x.png\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_the_editors_typed_text_is_saved_with_the_upload(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, body_zh=\"旧的正文。\")\n    assert upload(editor, edit_page, PNG, body_zh=\"还没保存的正文。\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"还没保存的正文。\" in editor.get(edit_page).text\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_upload_keeps_the_typed_text_on_screen_unsaved(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, body_zh=\"旧的正文。\")\n    response = upload(editor, edit_page, SVG, name=\"x.svg\", body_zh=\"还没保存的正文。\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"还没保存的正文。\" in response.text\n    assert \"还没保存的正文。\" not in editor.get(edit_page).text\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | tail -15","description":"Add upload validation tests and run them"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

the editor form comes along.\"\"\"\n    page = c.get(edit_page).text\n    return c.post(f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/images/{image_id(page, filename)}/delete\",\n                  data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(page), **(form_values(page) | fields)},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_an_image_the_text_still_uses_cannot_be_deleted(editor, tmp_path):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    filename = uploaded(editor, edit_page)\n    save(editor, edit_page, title_en=\"Pirates\", body_en=f\"![]({filename})\")\n    response = delete_image(editor, edit_page, filename)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"英文正文还在使用这张图片\" in response.text\n    assert images_on(editor.get(edit_page).text) == [filename]\n    assert files_in(tmp_path / \"media\") == {filename}\n\n\ndef test_an_unused_image_is_deleted_with_its_file(editor, tmp_path):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    kept = uploaded(editor, edit_page)\n    gone = uploaded(editor, edit_page)\n    save(editor, edit_page, body_zh=f\"![]({gone})\", cover=gone)\n    # The reference is removed in the same press of the button.\n    response = delete_image(editor, edit_page, gone, body_zh=\"不用图了。\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n    assert \"图片已删除\" in page\n    assert images_on(page) == [kept]\n    assert chosen_cover(page) == kept\n    assert files_in(tmp_path / \"media\") == {kept}\n    assert editor.get(image_url(edit_page, gone)).status_code == 404\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|Error|^E \" | head","description":"Add image deletion tests and run"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Slice 7 moves to Seam 2: the Site build copies images and links them with relative paths, using each language's alt text."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0186mHGGHChjvdQ8TwhXgaT5","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"tests/test_s1_images.py\"); s = p.read_text()\ns = s.replace('''from test_t06_revisions_trash import published_guide\n''', '''from test_t04_site_build import page as site_page, site  # noqa: F401\nfrom test_t03_guides import slug_of\nfrom test_t06_revisions_trash import published_guide\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n''')\ns += '''\n\ndef guide_with_images(editor: TestClient, admin: TestClient) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A Published Guide by the Editor using two described images, the second\n    as its cover. Returns its edit page and the two file names.\"\"\"\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    first, second = uploaded(editor, edit_page), uploaded(editor, edit_page)\n    describe(editor, edit_page, first, \"开局\", \"Opening\")\n    describe(editor, edit_page, second, \"终局阵容\", \"End-game lineup\", cover=second,\n             body_zh=f\"开局：![]({first})\\\\n\\\\n终局：![]({second})\",\n             title_en=\"Pirates\", body_en=f\"Opening: ![]({first})\")\n    assert act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    assert act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page, first, second\n\n\ndef shown_images(site: Path, path: str) -> list[tuple[Path, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Each image on the page at `path`: the file its src leads to, and its alt.\"\"\"\n    found = []\n    for tag in img_tags(site_page(site, path)):\n        src = re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]+)\"', tag)\n        alt = re.search(r'alt=\"([^\"]*)\"', tag)\n        assert src and alt, tag\n        assert not src.group(1).startswith(\"/\"), tag\n        found.append(((site / path / src.group(1)).resolve(), alt.group(1)))\n    return found\n\n\ndef test_the_site_build_copies_the_images_and_shows_each_languages_alt_text(\n        editor, admin, site):\n    edit_page, first, second = guide_with_images(editor, admin)\n    slug = slug_of(admin, edit_page)\n    render_site(site)\n    media = (site / \"media\").resolve()\n    assert (media / first).read_bytes() == PNG and (media / second).read_bytes() == PNG\n    assert shown_images(site, f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\") == [\n        (media / first, \"开局\"), (media / second, \"终局阵容\")]\n    assert shown_images(site, f\"en/guides/{slug}/\") == [(media / first, \"Opening\")]\n'''\np.write_text(s)\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|Error|^E \" | head","description":"Add Site build image test (expect red)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

s = p.read_text()\ns = s.replace(\"from test_t06_revisions_trash import published_guide\\n\",\n              \"from test_t06_revisions_trash import delete, delete_for_good, published_guide\\n\")\ns += '''\n\ndef test_images_of_guides_that_are_not_published_never_reach_the_site(editor, admin, site):\n    draft = new_guide(editor)\n    submitted = new_guide(editor)\n    trashed = published_guide(editor, admin)\n    hidden = [uploaded(editor, draft), uploaded(editor, submitted),\n              uploaded(admin, trashed)]\n    act(editor, submitted, \"submit\")\n    assert delete(admin, trashed).status_code == 303\n    _, *shown = guide_with_images(editor, admin)\n    render_site(site)\n    assert files_in(site / \"media\") == set(shown)\n    assert not any(name in file.read_text() for file in site.rglob(\"*.html\")\n                   for name in hidden)\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_guide_from_the_trash_for_good_deletes_its_images(\n        editor, admin, tmp_path):\n    edit_page, *_ = guide_with_images(editor, admin)\n    other = new_guide(editor)\n    kept = uploaded(editor, other)\n    assert delete(admin, edit_page).status_code == 303\n    assert len(files_in(tmp_path / \"media\")) == 3  # in the Trash, still there\n    assert delete_for_good(admin, edit_page).status_code == 303\n    assert files_in(tmp_path / \"media\") == {kept}\n'''\np.write_text(s)\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|Error|^E \" | head","description":"Add unpublished and delete-for-good tests"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

published_revision(editor: TestClient, admin: TestClient, edit_page: str,\n                       **fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The Editor revises their Published Guide and an Admin Publishes it.\"\"\"\n    assert open_revision(editor, edit_page).status_code == 303\n    revision = revision_page(edit_page)\n    assert save(editor, revision, **fields).status_code == 303\n    assert act(editor, revision, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    assert act(admin, revision, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_a_revision_that_changes_the_patch_moves_the_guide_to_that_patch_group(\n        editor, admin, site):\n    published_guide(editor, admin, title_zh=\"一直是6.7的攻略\")\n    edit_page = published_guide(editor, admin, title_zh=\"要改版本的攻略\")\n    hero = page(render_site(site), \"zh/heroes/vanessa/\")\n    assert hero.index(\"<h2>6.7</h2>\") < hero.index(\"要改版本的攻略\")\n    assert \"<h2>6.6</h2>\" not in hero\n\n    published_revision(editor, admin, edit_page, patch_id=patch_id(editor, \"6.6\"))\n    hero = page(render_site(site), \"zh/heroes/vanessa/\")\n    assert (hero.index(\"<h2>6.7</h2>\") < hero.index(\"一直是6.7的攻略\")\n            < hero.index(\"<h2>6.6</h2>\") < hero.index(\"要改版本的攻略\"))\n\n\ndef submitted_revision(editor: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Editor revises their Published Guide and Submits the Revision;\n    returns the Revision's edit page.\"\"\"\n    assert open_revision(editor, edit_page).status_code == 303\n    revision = revision_page(edit_page)\n    assert save(editor, revision, **fields).status_code == 303\n    assert act(editor, revision, \"submit\").status_code == 303\n    return revision\n\n\n486:def test_the_author_discards_their_revision_and_can_open_a_new_one(editor, admin):\n487-    edit_page = published_guide(editor, admin, title_zh=\"旧标题\")\n488-    revision = submitted_revision(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"不要了的修订\")\n489-    discard = f\"{revision.removesuffix('/edit')}/delete\"\n490-    assert f'href=\"../../../../{discard.removeprefix(\"/\")}\"' in editor.get(revision).text\n491-    confirm = editor.get(discard)\n492-    assert confirm.status_code == 200 and \"放弃\" in confirm.text\n493-\n494-    response = fill_in(editor, discard, discard)\n495-    assert response.status_code == 303\n496-    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == edit_page\n497-    assert \"修订已放弃\" in editor.get(edit_page).text\n498-    assert editor.get(revision).status_code == 404\n499-    assert \"不要了的修订\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/dashboard\").text\n500-    assert status_of(editor, edit_page) == \"已发布\"\n501-    assert the Published Guide, as it was\n    media = (site / \"media\").resolve()\n    assert shown_images(site, f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\") == [\n        (media / first, \"开局\"), (media / second, \"终局阵容\")]\n    assert files_in(media) == {first, second}\n\n    assert act(admin, revision, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    render_site(site)\n    assert shown_images(site, f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\") == [\n        (media / first, \"新的开局\"), (media / third, \"\")]\n    assert files_in(media) == {first, third}\n    [cover] = [item for item in list_items(site, \"zh/\") if \"<img\" in item]\n    assert third in cover\n    assert images_on(admin.get(edit_page).text) == [first, third]\n\n\ndef test_a_discarded_revision_leaves_the_guides_images_as_they_were(\n        editor, admin, tmp_path):\n    edit_page, first, second = guide_with_images(editor, admin)\n    open_revision(editor, edit_page)\n    revision = revision_page(edit_page)\n    extra = uploaded(editor, revision)\n    describe(editor, revision, first, \"改过的说明\", \"Changed\", cover=extra)\n    discard = f\"{revision.removesuffix('/edit')}/delete\"\n    assert fill_in(editor, discard, discard).status_code == 303\n\n    page = admin.get(edit_page).text\n    assert images_on(page) == [first, second]\n    assert 'value=\"开局\"' in page and chosen_cover(page) == second\n    assert files_in(tmp_path / \"media\") == {first, second}\n'''\np.write_text(s)\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_s1_images.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|Error|^E \" | head","description":"Add Revision image tests (expect red)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

An Admin saves a Draft and Publishes it, and can\nUnpublish it or delete it for good. Every function takes the acting user and\nrefuses anyone who can't manage_pages, whatever the route in front of it\nchecked. Anything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message\nto show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of, replace\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom typing import Protocol\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.guides import SLUG\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Page or Tournament item change the console refuses, with the reason\n    to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass NotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Page or Tournament item.\"\"\"\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\nclass TextBearing(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"What Pages and Tournament items share: a Chinese and an English text,\n    a status, and a place in the console. Read-only, as both are frozen.\"\"\"\n    @property\n    def id(self) -> int: ...\n    @property\n    def title_zh(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def body_zh(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def title_en(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def body_en(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def status(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str: ...\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str: ...\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool: ...\n\n\n        (slug, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en, fields.body_en,\n         page_id))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef _publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, item: TextBearing,\n             what: str) -> None:\n    if item.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(f\"这个{what}已经发布了。\")\n    _check_publishable(item.title_zh, item.body_zh, item.title_en, item.body_en)\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET status = 'published', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (item.id,))\n\n\ndef _unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, item: TextBearing,\n               what: str) -> None:\n    if item.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(f\"只有已发布的{what}才能撤下。\")\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET status = 'draft', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (item.id,))\n\n\ndef _record_removal(conn: sqlite3.Connection, kind: str, table: str,\n                    item: TextBearing) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Note an item about to be deleted for good, if it was ever Published,\n    for changes_since.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO removed_content (kind, item_id, was_published, site_changed_at)\"\n        f\" SELECT ?, id, status = 'published', site_changed_at FROM {table}\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?
